===== FILE: engine\translation-memory.js (632 bytes) =====
export async function saveTranslationMemory(db,source,target,sourceLang,targetLang){

if(!source || !target) return;

await db.collection("translationMemory").add({

source:source.trim(),
target:target.trim(),
sourceLang:sourceLang,
targetLang:targetLang,
createdAt:new Date()

});

}



export async function applyTranslationMemory(db,text){

const snapshot = await db.collection("translationMemory").get();

let output=text;

snapshot.forEach(doc=>{

const memory=doc.data();

if(memory.source && memory.target){

const regex=new RegExp(memory.source,"gi");

output=output.replace(regex,memory.target);

}

});

return output;

}


===== FILE: functions\index.js (1667 bytes) =====
const functions = require("firebase-functions");
const admin = require("firebase-admin");
const OpenAI = require("openai");

admin.initializeApp();

const db = admin.firestore();

const openai = new OpenAI({
  apiKey: functions.config().openai.key
});


exports.evaluateTranslator = functions.firestore
.document("translatorApplications/{applicantId}")
.onCreate(async (snap, context) => {

const data = snap.data();

const english = data.englishTranslation || "";
const french = data.frenchTranslation || "";

try{

const prompt = `
You are evaluating a professional translator application.

Evaluate the following translations and return a score from 0 to 100.

English translation:
${english}

French translation:
${french}

Return JSON only:

{
 "accuracy": number,
 "grammar": number,
 "terminology": number,
 "fluency": number
}
`;

const response = await openai.chat.completions.create({

model:"gpt-4o-mini",

messages:[
{role:"system",content:"You are a professional translation evaluator."},
{role:"user",content:prompt}
]

});

const result = JSON.parse(response.choices[0].message.content);

const finalScore = Math.round(
(result.accuracy * 0.4) +
(result.grammar * 0.25) +
(result.terminology * 0.2) +
(result.fluency * 0.15)
);

let status = "rejected";

if(finalScore >= 80){
status = "approved";
}

await snap.ref.update({

accuracyScore: result.accuracy,
grammarScore: result.grammar,
terminologyScore: result.terminology,
fluencyScore: result.fluency,

finalScore: finalScore,
status: status,

evaluatedAt: Date.now()

});

}catch(err){

console.error("Evaluation error:",err);

await snap.ref.update({

status:"evaluation_failed"

});

}

});

===== FILE: public\admin\passkey\passkey.js (3001 bytes) =====
(function () {
  const input = document.getElementById("passkeyInput");
  const status = document.getElementById("status");

  const MASTER_PASSKEY = "0110041181";
  const STORAGE_KEY = "saybon_admin_generated_passkeys";
  const ROLE_KEY = "saybon_admin_role";
  const ACTIVE_PASSKEY_KEY = "saybon_admin_active_passkey";
  const ACTIVE_PASSKEY_RECORD_KEY = "saybon_admin_active_passkey_record";

  let handled = false;
  let denyTimer = null;

  function getGeneratedPasskeys() {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      const parsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
      return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  function saveActiveSession(role, record) {
    localStorage.setItem(ROLE_KEY, role);
    localStorage.setItem(ACTIVE_PASSKEY_KEY, record.passkey || "");
    localStorage.setItem(ACTIVE_PASSKEY_RECORD_KEY, JSON.stringify(record));
  }

  function grant(record) {
    if (handled) return;
    handled = true;
    saveActiveSession(record.role || "employee_admin", record);
    window.location.href = "/admin/access-granted/";
  }

  function deny() {
    if (handled) return;
    handled = true;
    window.location.href = "/admin/access-denied/";
  }

  function resetTimer() {
    if (denyTimer) {
      clearTimeout(denyTimer);
      denyTimer = null;
    }
  }

  function buildAllowedRecords() {
    const generated = getGeneratedPasskeys()
      .filter(item => item && item.enabled === true)
      .map(item => ({
        name: item.name || "Employee",
        passkey: String(item.passkey || "").trim(),
        role: item.role || "employee_admin",
        employeeId: item.employeeId || ""
      }));

    return [
      {
        name: "Master Admin",
        passkey: MASTER_PASSKEY,
        role: "master_admin",
        employeeId: "MASTER"
      },
      ...generated
    ];
  }

  function validateNow() {
    if (handled) return;

    const key = String(input.value || "").trim();
    if (!key) return;

    const records = buildAllowedRecords();
    const matched = records.find(r => String(r.passkey).trim() === key);

    if (matched) {
      grant(matched);
      return;
    }

    const hasPrefixMatch = records.some(r => String(r.passkey).startsWith(key));
    if (!hasPrefixMatch) {
      deny();
    }
  }

  input.addEventListener("input", () => {
    if (handled) return;
    resetTimer();

    const key = String(input.value || "").trim();
    if (!key) return;

    const records = buildAllowedRecords();
    const matched = records.find(r => String(r.passkey).trim() === key);

    if (matched) {
      grant(matched);
      return;
    }

    denyTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      validateNow();
    }, 700);
  });

  input.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (e.key === "Enter") {
      resetTimer();
      validateNow();
    }
  });

  input.addEventListener("blur", () => {
    resetTimer();
    validateNow();
  });

  if (status) {
    status.textContent = "";
  }
})();

===== FILE: public\auth\login.js (3273 bytes) =====
import { initializeApp } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.7.1/firebase-app.js";
import {
  getAuth,
  GoogleAuthProvider,
  signInWithPopup,
  signInWithEmailAndPassword,
  createUserWithEmailAndPassword
} from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.7.1/firebase-auth.js";

const firebaseConfig = {
  apiKey: "[REDACTED]",
  authDomain: "saybon-3e3c2.firebaseapp.com",
  projectId: "saybon-3e3c2",
  appId: "1:75085012344:web:0b18581cb0a30c3df47c8d"
};

const app = initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
const auth = getAuth(app);
const provider = new GoogleAuthProvider();

document.getElementById("backBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
  if(window.stopAppBgMusic){ window.stopAppBgMusic(); } window.location.href = "/";
});

document.getElementById("loginBtn").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  try {
    await signInWithPopup(auth, provider);

    // LOCKED BEHAVIOR:
    // Always goes directly to dashboard
    window.location.href = "/dashboard/";

  } catch (err) {
    alert("Login cancelled or failed.");
  }
});





let isSignUpMode = false;

document.getElementById("toggleModeBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
  isSignUpMode = !isSignUpMode;
  document.getElementById("emailAuthBtn").textContent = isSignUpMode ? "Create Account" : "Sign In";
  document.getElementById("toggleModeText").textContent = isSignUpMode ? "Already have an account?" : "New here?";
  document.getElementById("toggleModeBtn").textContent = isSignUpMode ? "Sign In" : "Create Account";
  document.getElementById("emailAuthError").textContent = "";
});

document.getElementById("emailAuthForm").addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const email = document.getElementById("emailInput").value.trim();
  const password = document.getElementById("passwordInput").value;
  const errorEl = document.getElementById("emailAuthError");
  errorEl.textContent = "";

  try {
    if (isSignUpMode) {
      await createUserWithEmailAndPassword(auth, email, password);
    } else {
      await signInWithEmailAndPassword(auth, email, password);
    }
    window.location.href = "/dashboard/";
  } catch (err) {
    if (err.code === "auth/email-already-in-use") {
      errorEl.textContent = "That email is already registered. Try signing in instead.";
    } else if (err.code === "auth/weak-password") {
      errorEl.textContent = "Password should be at least 6 characters.";
    } else if (err.code === "auth/invalid-email") {
      errorEl.textContent = "Please enter a valid email address.";
    } else if (err.code === "auth/wrong-password" || err.code === "auth/invalid-credential") {
      errorEl.textContent = "Incorrect email or password.";
    } else if (err.code === "auth/user-not-found") {
      errorEl.textContent = "No account found with that email.";
    } else {
      errorEl.textContent = "Something went wrong. Please try again.";
    }
  }
});

document.getElementById("emailIconBtn").addEventListener("click", () => {
  const form = document.getElementById("emailAuthForm");
  const divider = document.querySelector(".email-divider");
  const isOpen = form.style.display === "flex";
  form.style.display = isOpen ? "none" : "flex";
  divider.style.display = isOpen ? "none" : "flex";
});

const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";

function unlock(){
  if(false){
    sessionStorage.setItem("chatAdminVerified","true");
    document.getElementById("login").style.display = "none";
    document.getElementById("panel").style.display = "block";
    loadAll();
  }else{
    alert("Incorrect passcode");
  }
}
window.unlock = unlock; window.addEventListener("adminAuthorized", function(){ document.getElementById("login").style.display = "none"; document.getElementById("panel").style.display = "block"; loadAll(); });

if(sessionStorage.getItem("chatAdminVerified") === "true"){
  document.getElementById("login").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("panel").style.display = "block";
  loadAll();
}

document.querySelectorAll(".tab-btn").forEach(btn=>{
  btn.addEventListener("click", ()=>{
    document.querySelectorAll(".tab-btn").forEach(b=>b.classList.remove("active"));
    document.querySelectorAll(".tab-panel").forEach(p=>p.classList.remove("active"));
    btn.classList.add("active");
    document.getElementById("panel-"+btn.dataset.tab).classList.add("active");
  });
});

function loadAll(){
  loadUsers();
  loadViolations();
  loadRooms();
}

let cachedUsers = [];
let cachedViolations = [];
let cachedRooms = [];

function renderOverview(){
  const grid = document.getElementById("statGrid");
  const blockedCount = cachedUsers.filter(u=>u.blocked).length;
  const flaggedCount = cachedUsers.filter(u=>u.flagged).length;
  const cards = [
    {label:"Total Users Tracked", value:cachedUsers.length},
    {label:"Blocked Users", value:blockedCount},
    {label:"Flagged Users", value:flaggedCount},
    {label:"Total Violations", value:cachedViolations.length},
    {label:"Custom Rooms", value:cachedRooms.length}
  ];
  grid.innerHTML = cards.map(c=>"<div class='stat-card'><div class='stat-label'>"+c.label+"</div><div class='stat-value'>"+c.value+"</div></div>").join("");
}

async function loadUsers(){

  const table = document.getElementById("usersTable");
  const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminChatUsers");
  cachedUsers = await res.json();

  if(!cachedUsers.length){
    table.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='4' class='empty-note'>No user activity tracked yet.</td></tr>";
    renderOverview();
    return;
  }

  table.innerHTML = "";

  cachedUsers.forEach(u=>{
    const row = document.createElement("tr");
    const statusBadge = u.blocked ? "<span class='badge badge-blocked'>Blocked</span>" : u.flagged ? "<span class='badge badge-flagged'>Flagged</span>" : "<span class='badge badge-clean'>Clean</span>";
    row.innerHTML =
      "<td>"+escapeHtml(u.displayName)+"</td>"+
      "<td>"+u.violationCount+"</td>"+
      "<td>"+statusBadge+"</td>"+
      "<td>"+
        (u.blocked
          ? "<button class='action-btn btn-unblock' onclick=\"unblockUser('"+u.uid+"')\">Unblock</button>"
          : "<button class='action-btn btn-block' onclick=\"blockUser('"+u.uid+"','"+escapeHtml(u.displayName).replace(/'/g,"\\'")+"')\">Block</button>")+
        "<button class='action-btn btn-flag' onclick=\"toggleFlag('"+u.uid+"','"+escapeHtml(u.displayName).replace(/'/g,"\\'")+"',"+(!u.flagged)+")\">"+(u.flagged?"Unflag":"Flag")+"</button>"+
      "</td>";
    table.appendChild(row);
  });

  renderOverview();

}

window.blockUser = async function(uid, displayName){
  await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminBlockUser", {method:"POST", headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"}, body:JSON.stringify({uid, displayName})});
  loadUsers();
}

window.unblockUser = async function(uid){
  await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminUnblockUser", {method:"POST", headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"}, body:JSON.stringify({uid})});
  loadUsers();
}

window.toggleFlag = async function(uid, displayName, flagged){
  await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminFlagUser", {method:"POST", headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"}, body:JSON.stringify({uid, displayName, flagged})});
  loadUsers();
}

async function loadViolations(){

  const table = document.getElementById("violationsTable");
  const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminChatViolations");
  cachedViolations = await res.json();

  if(!cachedViolations.length){
    table.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='4' class='empty-note'>No violations logged yet.</td></tr>";
    renderOverview();
    return;
  }

  table.innerHTML = "";

  cachedViolations.forEach(v=>{
    const row = document.createElement("tr");
    row.innerHTML =
      "<td>"+escapeHtml(v.displayName)+"</td>"+
      "<td>"+escapeHtml(v.roomId)+"</td>"+
      "<td>"+escapeHtml(v.matchedTerm)+"</td>"+
      "<td>"+escapeHtml(v.messageText)+"</td>";
    table.appendChild(row);
  });

  renderOverview();

}

async function loadRooms(){

  const table = document.getElementById("roomsTable");
  const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminChatCustomRooms");
  cachedRooms = await res.json();

  if(!cachedRooms.length){
    table.innerHTML = "<tr><td colspan='3' class='empty-note'>No custom rooms created yet.</td></tr>";
    renderOverview();
    return;
  }

  table.innerHTML = "";

  cachedRooms.forEach(r=>{
    const row = document.createElement("tr");
    row.innerHTML =
      "<td>"+escapeHtml(r.name)+"</td>"+
      "<td>"+escapeHtml(r.lastMessage||"")+"</td>"+
      "<td><button class='action-btn btn-delete' onclick=\"deleteRoom('"+r.id+"')\">Delete</button></td>";
    table.appendChild(row);
  });

  renderOverview();

}

window.deleteRoom = async function(roomId){
  if(!confirm("Delete this custom room? This cannot be undone.")) return;
  await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminDeleteChatRoom", {method:"POST", headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"}, body:JSON.stringify({roomId})});
  loadRooms();
}

function escapeHtml(str){
  const div = document.createElement("div");
  div.textContent = str == null ? "" : String(str);
  return div.innerHTML;
}

</script>

function escapeHtml(str) {
  const div = document.createElement("div");
  div.textContent = str == null ? "" : String(str);
  return div.innerHTML;
}

function formatPreviewTime(ts) {
  if (!ts || !ts.toDate) return "";
  const date = ts.toDate();
  const now = new Date();
  if (date.toDateString() === now.toDateString()) {
    return date.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: "numeric", minute: "2-digit" });
  }
  const diffDays = Math.floor((now - date) / 86400000);
  if (diffDays === 1) return "Yesterday";
  if (diffDays < 7) return diffDays + "d ago";
  return date.toLocaleDateString([], { month: "short", day: "numeric" });
}

function openRoom(roomId, roomName) {
  document.querySelectorAll(".conversation-item, .new-chat-btn").forEach(b => b.classList.remove("active"));
  const btn = document.querySelector('.room-btn[data-room-id="' + roomId + '"]');
  if (btn) btn.classList.add("active");

  welcomeWorkspace.classList.add("hidden");
  chatWorkspace.classList.remove("hidden");

  document.querySelector(".chatroom-shell").classList.add("mobile-chat-open");

  roomTitle.innerHTML = roomName;
  if (btn) {
    const srcAvatar = btn.querySelector(".conversation-avatar");
    roomAvatar.innerHTML = srcAvatar ? srcAvatar.innerHTML : "";
  }
  currentRoomId = roomId;

  subscribeToRoom(roomId);
}

confirmCreateRoomBtn.addEventListener("click", async () => {

  if (!currentUser) {
    alert("Please sign in to create a room.");
    return;
  }

  const name = newRoomNameInput.value.trim();
  if (!name) return;

  const roomId = "custom-" + slugify(name) + "-" + Date.now().toString(36).slice(-4);

  confirmCreateRoomBtn.disabled = true;

  try{

    await setDoc(doc(db, "chatRooms", roomId), {
      name,
      isCustom: true,
      createdBy: currentUser.uid,
      createdAt: serverTimestamp()
    });

    customRoomsLabel.style.display = "block";
    const btn = buildCustomRoomButton(roomId, name);
    customRoomsList.appendChild(btn);

    createRoomModal.classList.add("hidden");
    openRoom(roomId, name);

  }catch(err){
    alert("Could not create the room. Please try again.");
  }finally{
    confirmCreateRoomBtn.disabled = false;
  }

});

async function loadCustomRooms(){
  try{
    const snap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, "chatRooms"), where("isCustom","==",true)));
    if (snap.empty) return;

    const rooms = [];
    snap.forEach(d => rooms.push({ id: d.id, ...d.data() }));
    rooms.sort((a,b) => {
      const aT = a.createdAt && a.createdAt.seconds ? a.createdAt.seconds : 0;
      const bT = b.createdAt && b.createdAt.seconds ? b.createdAt.seconds : 0;
      return aT - bT;
    });

    customRoomsLabel.style.display = "block";
    rooms.forEach(r => {
      customRoomsList.appendChild(buildCustomRoomButton(r.id, r.name));
    });

  }catch(err){
    console.error("Could not load custom rooms:", err);
  }
}

loadCustomRooms();

let mediaRecorder = null;
let recordedChunks = [];
let micStream = null;

function stopMicStream(){
  if (micStream) {
    micStream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
    micStream = null;
  }
}

voiceBtn.addEventListener("click", async () => {

  try {
    micStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
  } catch (err) {
    alert("Could not access your microphone. Please allow microphone permission and try again.");
    return;
  }

  composer.classList.add("hidden");
  recordingPanel.classList.remove("hidden");
  recordingSeconds = 0;
  recordingTimer.innerHTML = "0:00";

  recordedChunks = [];
  mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(micStream);
  mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = (e) => { if (e.data.size > 0) recordedChunks.push(e.data); };
  if(window.pauseAppBgMusicForRecording){ window.pauseAppBgMusicForRecording(); } mediaRecorder.start();

  recordingInterval = setInterval(() => {
    recordingSeconds++;
    const mins = Math.floor(recordingSeconds / 60);
    const secs = recordingSeconds % 60;
    recordingTimer.innerHTML = mins + ":" + secs.toString().padStart(2, "0");
  }, 1000);

});

cancelRecording.addEventListener("click", () => {
  clearInterval(recordingInterval);
  if (mediaRecorder && mediaRecorder.state !== "inactive") {
    mediaRecorder.onstop = null;
    mediaRecorder.stop(); if(window.resumeAppBgMusicAfterRecording){ window.resumeAppBgMusicAfterRecording(); }
  }
  stopMicStream();
  recordingPanel.classList.add("hidden");
  composer.classList.remove("hidden");
});

document.getElementById("sendRecording").addEventListener("click", () => {

  clearInterval(recordingInterval);
  recordingPanel.classList.add("hidden");
  composer.classList.remove("hidden");

  if (!mediaRecorder || mediaRecorder.state === "inactive" || !currentRoomId || !currentUser) {
    stopMicStream();
    return;
  }

  mediaRecorder.onstop = async () => {

    stopMicStream();

    const blob = new Blob(recordedChunks, { type: "audio/webm" });
    const displayName = currentUser.displayName || currentUser.email || "Learner";

    try {

      const fileRef = storageRef(chatStorage, "chatVoiceNotes/" + currentRoomId + "/" + Date.now() + ".webm");
      await uploadBytesResumable(fileRef, blob);
      const fileUrl = await getDownloadURL(fileRef);

      await addDoc(collection(db, "chatRooms", currentRoomId, "messages"), {
        uid: currentUser.uid,
        displayName,
        type: "voice",
        fileUrl,
        createdAt: serverTimestamp()
      });

      await setDoc(doc(db, "chatRooms", currentRoomId), {
        lastMessage: "Voice note",
        lastMessageAt: serverTimestamp(),
        lastSenderName: displayName
      }, { merge: true });

    } catch (err) {
      console.error("Voice note upload failed:", err);
      alert("Could not send voice note. Please try again.");
    }

  };

  mediaRecorder.stop(); if(window.resumeAppBgMusicAfterRecording){ window.resumeAppBgMusicAfterRecording(); }

});

const chatWarningBanner = document.getElementById("chatWarningBanner");

function showChatWarning(msg){
  chatWarningBanner.textContent = msg;
  chatWarningBanner.classList.remove("hidden");
  setTimeout(() => chatWarningBanner.classList.add("hidden"), 6000);
}

async function sendMessage() {
  const text = composerInput.value.trim();
  if (!text || !currentRoomId || !currentUser) return;

  const displayName = currentUser.displayName || currentUser.email || "Learner";

  try {

    const statusRes = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/chatUserStatus?uid=" + encodeURIComponent(currentUser.uid));
    const status = await statusRes.json();

    if (status.blocked) {
      showChatWarning("Your account has been blocked from sending messages due to repeated violations. Contact support if you believe this is a mistake.");
      return;
    }

    const checkRes = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/chatCheckContent", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ text })
    });
    const check = await checkRes.json();

    if (!check.allowed) {

      const violationRes = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/chatRecordViolation", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          uid: currentUser.uid,
          displayName,
          roomId: currentRoomId,
          messageText: text,
          matchedTerm: check.matchedTerm
        })
      });
      const violation = await violationRes.json();

      if (violation.blocked) {
        showChatWarning("This message was not sent, and your account has now been blocked after repeated violations of our content guidelines.");
      } else {
        showChatWarning("This message was not sent - it contains content that is not allowed here. Warning " + violation.violationCount + " of 3. Continued violations will result in a block.");
      }

      return;

    }

  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Content check failed:", err);
  }

  composerInput.value = "";

  try {
    await addDoc(collection(db, "chatRooms", currentRoomId, "messages"), {
      uid: currentUser.uid,
      displayName: displayName,
      text: text,
      createdAt: serverTimestamp()
    });

    const preview = text.length > 60 ? text.slice(0, 60) + "..." : text;

    await setDoc(doc(db, "chatRooms", currentRoomId), {
      lastMessage: preview,
      lastMessageAt: serverTimestamp(),
      lastSenderName: displayName
    }, { merge: true });

  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Send failed:", err);
    showChatWarning("Could not send message. Please try again.");
  }
}
sendBtn.addEventListener("click", sendMessage);
composerInput.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) {
    e.preventDefault();
    sendMessage();
  }
});

// =========================================================
// REAL-TIME MESSAGE LISTENER
// =========================================================

function subscribeToRoom(roomId) {
  if (unsubscribeMessages) {
    unsubscribeMessages();
    unsubscribeMessages = null;
  }

  messagesContainer.innerHTML = "";

  const q = query(collection(db, "chatRooms", roomId, "messages"), orderBy("createdAt"));

  unsubscribeMessages = onSnapshot(q, (snapshot) => {
    messagesContainer.innerHTML = "";

    snapshot.forEach(docSnap => {
      const msg = docSnap.data();
      const isOwn = currentUser && msg.uid === currentUser.uid;

      const row = document.createElement("div");
      row.className = "message-row" + (isOwn ? " outgoing" : "");

      const name = escapeHtml(msg.displayName || "Learner");
      const initial = escapeHtml((msg.displayName || "?").charAt(0).toUpperCase());
      const text = escapeHtml(msg.text || "");

      let inner = "";
      if (!isOwn) inner += "<div class=\"message-avatar\">" + initial + "</div>";
      inner += "<div class=\"message-bubble " + (isOwn ? "outgoing-bubble" : "incoming-bubble") + "\">";
      if (!isOwn) inner += "<div class=\"message-user\">" + name + "</div>";

      if (msg.type === "file") {

        const isImage = msg.fileType && msg.fileType.indexOf("image/") === 0;

        if (isImage) {
          inner += "<img class=\"message-image\" src=\"" + msg.fileUrl + "\" onclick=\"window.open('" + msg.fileUrl + "','_blank')\">";
        } else {
          inner += "<div class=\"message-file-card\" onclick=\"window.open('" + msg.fileUrl + "','_blank')\">" +
            "<svg viewBox='0 0 24 24' width='20' height='20' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1.8'><path d='M14 2H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v16a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h12a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V8z'/><path d='M14 2v6h6'/></svg>" +
            "<span>" + escapeHtml(msg.fileName || "File") + "</span>" +
            "</div>";
        }

      } else if (msg.type === "voice") {

        inner += "<audio controls src=\"" + msg.fileUrl + "\" style=\"max-width:220px;\"></audio>";

      } else {

        inner += "<div>" + text + "</div>";

      }

      inner += "</div>";

      row.innerHTML = inner;
      messagesContainer.appendChild(row);
    });

    messagesContainer.scrollTop = messagesContainer.scrollHeight;
  });
}

<script>
function showJsError(msg){
  var el = document.getElementById("errorBanner");
  el.style.display = "block";
  el.textContent += msg + "\n\n";
}
window.addEventListener("error", function(e){
  showJsError("ERROR: " + e.message + " (line " + e.lineno + ", col " + e.colno + ")\nFile: " + e.filename);
});
window.addEventListener("unhandledrejection", function(e){
  showJsError("UNHANDLED PROMISE REJECTION: " + (e.reason && e.reason.message ? e.reason.message : e.reason));
});
</script>

import { auth } from "/js/firebase-init.js";
const API = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
const RM = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
const $$ = (s) => Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(s));
const C = 2 * Math.PI * 42;
const MILESTONES = [3, 7, 14, 30, 50, 100, 200, 365];

// wake the (sleepy) server early so Progress and Achievements load fast
try { fetch(API + "/api/activity/ping", { mode: "no-cors" }).catch(() => {}); } catch (e) {}

function localDay() { const d = new Date(); return d.getFullYear() + "-" + ("0" + (d.getMonth() + 1)).slice(-2) + "-" + ("0" + d.getDate()).slice(-2); }
function safe(f, d) { try { return f(); } catch (e) { return d; } }

function roll(el, from, to, ms) {
  if (RM || from === to) { el.textContent = to; return; }
  const t0 = performance.now();
  (function step(t) {
    const p = Math.min((t - t0) / ms, 1);
    el.textContent = Math.round(from + (to - from) * (1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 3)));
    if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step);
  })(t0);
}

function confetti() {
  if (RM) return;
  const box = document.createElement("div"); box.className = "sb-confetti";
  const bits = ["🔥", "⭐", "🎉", "✨", "💛"];
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    const s = document.createElement("span");
    s.textContent = bits[i % bits.length];
    s.style.left = Math.random() * 100 + "vw";
    s.style.animationDuration = 1.8 + Math.random() * 1.6 + "s";
    s.style.animationDelay = Math.random() * 0.6 + "s";
    box.appendChild(s);
  }
  document.body.appendChild(box); setTimeout(() => box.remove(), 4500);
}
function toast(msg) {
  const t = document.createElement("div"); t.className = "sb-toast"; t.textContent = msg;
  document.body.appendChild(t);
  requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => t.classList.add("show")));
  setTimeout(() => { t.classList.remove("show"); setTimeout(() => t.remove(), 600); }, 3200);
}

function animateStreak(streak) {
  const seen = Number(safe(() => localStorage.getItem("sb_seen_streak"), 0)) || 0;
  const flames = $$(".dash-streak-flame");
  const nums = $$(".js-streak-num");
  nums.forEach((n) => roll(n, Math.min(seen, streak), streak, 900));
  if (streak > 0) {
    flames.forEach((f) => {
      if (!RM && streak !== seen) { f.classList.add("fly"); setTimeout(() => { f.classList.remove("fly"); f.classList.add("lit"); }, 950); }
      else f.classList.add("lit");
    });
    if (streak > seen && !RM) nums.forEach((n) => setTimeout(() => n.classList.add("bump"), 900));
    if (streak > seen && MILESTONES.indexOf(streak) >= 0) {
      setTimeout(() => { confetti(); toast("🔥 " + streak + "-day streak!"); }, 900);
    }
  } else flames.forEach((f) => (f.style.opacity = ".55"));
  safe(() => localStorage.setItem("sb_seen_streak", String(streak)));
}

function setRing(minutes, goal) {
  const pct = Math.min(minutes / goal, 1);
  $$(".js-goal-ring-fill").forEach((r) => {
    r.style.strokeDasharray = C;
    r.style.strokeDashoffset = C;
    r.getBoundingClientRect();
    requestAnimationFrame(() => { r.style.strokeDashoffset = C * (1 - pct); });
    r.classList.toggle("is-done", pct >= 1);
  });
  $$(".dash-goal-ring-wrap").forEach((w) => w.classList.toggle("is-done", pct >= 1));
  $$(".js-goal-minutes").forEach((n) => roll(n, 0, Math.floor(minutes), 900));
  $$(".dash-goal-ring-text small").forEach((s) => (s.textContent = "/" + goal + " min"));
}

function lines(st) {
  const m = Math.floor(st.today.seconds / 60), g = st.goalMinutes, left = Math.max(g - m, 0);
  const next = [
    ["Try a lesson", "Pick up where you left off"],
    ["Play a mission", "Talkletics is waiting"],
    ["Put some music on", "Listening counts too"]
  ];
  let L = [];
  if (st.today.goalMet) {
    L.push(["Goal done", "Keep the flame going"]);
    L.push(["Bonus time", "Extra practice sticks"]);
    L.push(next[0], next[1], next[2]);
  } else if (m === 0) {
    L.push(["Ready when you are", g + " minutes to go"]);
    if (st.streak > 0 && !st.countedToday) L.push(["Keep the flame", "Day " + (st.streak + 1) + " awaits"]);
    L.push(["Start small", "One lesson counts"]);
    L.push(next[0], next[1], next[2]);
  } else {
    L.push([m + (m === 1 ? " minute in" : " minutes in"), left + " to go"]);
    L.push(["Nice rhythm", left + (left === 1 ? " minute left" : " minutes left")]);
    L.push(next[1], next[2], next[0]);
  }
  return L;
}

let tickTimer = null;
function ticker(st) {
  const L = lines(st);
  $$(".js-goal-caption").forEach((cap) => {
    cap.classList.add("sb-ticker"); cap.textContent = "";
    const mk = (l) => { const d = document.createElement("div"); d.className = "tk"; const h = document.createElement("span"); h.className = "tk-h"; h.textContent = l[0]; const s = document.createElement("span"); s.className = "tk-s"; s.textContent = l[1]; d.append(h, s); cap.appendChild(d); return d; };
    let i = 0, cur = mk(L[0]); requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => cur.classList.add("in")));
    cap._tk = setInterval(() => {
      const old = cur; i = (i + 1) % L.length; cur = mk(L[i]);
      requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => cur.classList.add("in")));
      old.classList.remove("in"); old.classList.add("out"); setTimeout(() => old.remove(), 600);
    }, 3800);
  });
}

function fallbackTicker() { /* API unreachable: keep the original static caption */ }

async function load(user) {
  const token = await user.getIdToken();
  const r = await fetch(API + "/api/activity/summary?day=" + localDay(), { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer " + token } });
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error("summary " + r.status);
  return r.json();
}

let started = false;
function render(st) {
  $$(".js-goal-caption").forEach((c) => c._tk && clearInterval(c._tk));
  const minutes = st.today.seconds / 60;
  setRing(minutes, st.goalMinutes);
  animateStreak(st.streak);
  ticker(st);
}

function applyProfile(user) {
  const name = user.displayName || "";
  if (name) $$(".dash-profile-name").forEach((n) => (n.textContent = name));
  $$(".dash-avatar").forEach((a) => {
    if (user.photoURL) { a.textContent = ""; const i = document.createElement("img"); i.alt = ""; i.src = user.photoURL; a.appendChild(i); }
    else if (name) a.textContent = name.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
  });
}

auth.onAuthStateChanged(async (user) => {
  if (user) applyProfile(user);
  if (!user || started) return; started = true;
  try { render(await load(user)); } catch (e) { console.warn("dashboard-live:", e); fallbackTicker(); }
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", async () => {
    if (document.visibilityState === "visible") { try { render(await load(user)); } catch (e) {} }
  });
});

===== FILE: public\dashboard\level-sync.js (1745 bytes) =====
import { auth } from "/js/firebase-init.js";
import { onAuthStateChanged } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth.js";
const API = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
const show = (lv) => document.querySelectorAll(".js-profile-level").forEach((el) => { el.textContent = lv; });
function local() { try { return sessionStorage.getItem("saybon_level"); } catch (e) { return null; } }
async function call(user, method, body, tries) {
  for (let i = 0; i < tries; i++) {
    try {
      const t = await user.getIdToken();
      const r = await fetch(API + "/api/level", { method, headers: Object.assign({ Authorization: "Bearer " + t }, body ? { "Content-Type": "application/json" } : {}), body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined });
      if (r.ok) return await r.json();
    } catch (e) { }
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 4000));
  }
  return null;
}
onAuthStateChanged(auth, async (user) => {
  if (!user || (user.isAnonymous && !user.email)) return;
  const lv = local();
  if (lv && /^[A-C][0-2]$/i.test(lv)) {
    show(lv.toUpperCase());
    call(user, "POST", { level: lv }, 5);          // save it to the account
    return;
  }
  const d = await call(user, "GET", null, 6);      // nothing in this browser: ask the account
  if (d && d.level) {
    try { sessionStorage.setItem("saybon_level", d.level); localStorage.removeItem("saybon_start_scratch"); } catch (e) { }
    show(d.level);
    return;
  }
  // No level anywhere (a new learner, or "Start from scratch"): the starting level is A0
  if (d) {
    try { sessionStorage.setItem("saybon_level", "A0"); localStorage.removeItem("saybon_start_scratch"); } catch (e) { }
    show("A0");
    call(user, "POST", { level: "A0" }, 5);
  }
});

document.getElementById("adUploadBtn").addEventListener("click", uploadAsset);

function uploadAsset(){
  var name = document.getElementById("adNameInput").value.trim();
  var type = document.getElementById("adTypeInput").value;
  var fileInput = document.getElementById("adFileInput");
  var status = document.getElementById("adUploadStatus");

  if(!name || !fileInput.files[0]){
    status.textContent = "Name and file are both required";
    status.className = "ad-status ad-error";
    return;
  }

  status.textContent = "Uploading...";
  status.className = "ad-status";

  var file = fileInput.files[0];
  var storageRef = ref(storage, "delfAssets/" + name + "-" + Date.now() + "-" + file.name);

  uploadBytes(storageRef, file).then(function(snapshot){
    return getDownloadURL(snapshot.ref);
  }).then(function(url){
    return fetch(API_BASE + "/api/delfAdminAddAsset", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ name: name, type: type, url: url })
    });
  }).then(function(res){
    return res.json();
  }).then(function(data){
    status.textContent = "Uploaded successfully";
    status.className = "ad-status ad-success";
    document.getElementById("adNameInput").value = "";
    fileInput.value = "";
    loadAssets();
  }).catch(function(err){
    console.error(err);
    status.textContent = "Upload failed: " + (err.message || "check console");
    status.className = "ad-status ad-error";
  });
}

function loadAssets(){
  var list = document.getElementById("adAssetList");
  list.innerHTML = '<p class="ad-empty">Loading...</p>';

  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/delfAssets").then(function(res){ return res.json(); }).then(function(assets){
    if(!assets || assets.length === 0){
      list.innerHTML = '<p class="ad-empty">No assets uploaded yet</p>';
      return;
    }
    list.innerHTML = assets.map(function(a){
      return '<div class="ad-row">' +
        '<div><div class="ad-row-name">' + a.name + '</div><div class="ad-row-type">' + a.type + '</div></div>' +
        '<div class="ad-row-actions">' +
        '<button class="ad-rename-btn" data-id="' + a.id + '">Rename</button>' +
        '<button class="ad-delete-btn" data-id="' + a.id + '">Delete</button>' +
        '</div></div>';
    }).join("");

    document.querySelectorAll(".ad-delete-btn").forEach(function(btn){
      btn.addEventListener("click", function(){ deleteAsset(btn.getAttribute("data-id")); });
    });
    document.querySelectorAll(".ad-rename-btn").forEach(function(btn){
      btn.addEventListener("click", function(){ renameAsset(btn.getAttribute("data-id")); });
    });
  }).catch(function(err){
    console.error(err);
    list.innerHTML = '<p class="ad-empty">Could not load assets</p>';
  });
}

function deleteAsset(id){
  if(!confirm("Delete this asset?")) return;
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/delfAdminDeleteAsset", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ assetId: id })
  }).then(function(){ loadAssets(); });
}

function renameAsset(id){
  var newName = prompt("New name for this asset:");
  if(!newName) return;
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/delfAdminRenameAsset", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ assetId: id, newName: newName })
  }).then(function(){ loadAssets(); });
}

const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
import { auth } from "/js/firebase-init.js";
import { onAuthStateChanged, signOut } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth.js";

var LABEL = { a1:"A1", a2:"A2", b1:"B1", b2:"B2", c1:"C1", c2:"C2", prim:"DELF Prim", junior:"DELF Junior" };
var root = document.getElementById("dxRoot");
var gid = 0;
function esc(s){ return String(s == null ? "" : s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function(c){ return {"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c]; }); }
function fmt(ms){ return ms ? new Date(ms).toLocaleDateString(undefined,{year:"numeric",month:"short",day:"numeric"}) : ""; }
function pc(x){ return Math.round((x || 0) * 100); }

function nameOf(user){
  if(user.displayName) return user.displayName;
  var e = user.email || "";
  var base = e.split("@")[0].replace(/[._\-+0-9]+/g, " ").trim();
  if(!base) return "Learner";
  return base.split(" ").map(function(w){ return w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1); }).join(" ");
}

// one clean ring for the placement result
function ring(pct, size, stroke, inner, sub){
  var r = (size - stroke) / 2, C = 2 * Math.PI * r;
  var off = C * (1 - Math.max(0, Math.min(100, pct)) / 100);
  return '<div class="dx-ring" style="width:' + size + 'px;height:' + size + 'px">' +
    '<svg width="' + size + '" height="' + size + '" viewBox="0 0 ' + size + ' ' + size + '">' +
    '<circle class="dx-bg" cx="' + size/2 + '" cy="' + size/2 + '" r="' + r + '" stroke-width="' + stroke + '"/>' +
    '<circle class="dx-fg" cx="' + size/2 + '" cy="' + size/2 + '" r="' + r + '" stroke-width="' + stroke + '" stroke-dasharray="' + C + '" stroke-dashoffset="' + C + '" data-off="' + off + '"/>' +
    '</svg><div class="dx-ring-mid"><div class="dx-ring-num">' + inner + '</div>' + (sub ? '<div class="dx-ring-sub">' + sub + '</div>' : '') + '</div></div>';
}
function animateRings(){
  requestAnimationFrame(function(){ requestAnimationFrame(function(){
    var els = root.querySelectorAll(".dx-fg");
    for(var i = 0; i < els.length; i++){ els[i].style.strokeDashoffset = els[i].getAttribute("data-off"); }
    var fills = root.querySelectorAll(".dx-fill");
    for(var j = 0; j < fills.length; j++){ fills[j].style.width = fills[j].getAttribute("data-w") + "%"; }
  }); });
}

// progress line chart: placement baseline, then each mock exam
function chart(points){
  if(points.length < 2){
    return '<p class="dx-chart-empty">Your baseline is set. Take your first mock exam and your progress line starts here.</p>';
  }
  var W = 600, H = 210, L = 34, R = 34, T = 18, B = 34, iw = W - L - R, ih = H - T - B;
  var x = function(i){ return L + iw * i / (points.length - 1); };
  var y = function(v){ return T + ih * (1 - v / 100); };
  var grid = "";
  [0, 50, 100].forEach(function(g){
    grid += '<line x1="' + L + '" x2="' + (W - R) + '" y1="' + y(g) + '" y2="' + y(g) + '" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,' + (g === 50 ? '.18' : '.06') + ')"' + (g === 50 ? ' stroke-dasharray="4 5"' : '') + '/>' +
      '<text x="' + (L - 8) + '" y="' + (y(g) + 4) + '" text-anchor="end">' + g + '</text>';
  });
  var line = points.map(function(p, i){ return (i ? "L" : "M") + x(i).toFixed(1) + " " + y(p.v).toFixed(1); }).join(" ");
  var dots = points.map(function(p, i){
    return '<circle cx="' + x(i).toFixed(1) + '" cy="' + y(p.v).toFixed(1) + '" r="4.5" fill="#d9b36c"/>' +
      '<text class="dx-pt-l" x="' + x(i).toFixed(1) + '" y="' + (y(p.v) - 11).toFixed(1) + '" text-anchor="middle">' + Math.round(p.v) + '</text>' +
      '<text x="' + x(i).toFixed(1) + '" y="' + (H - 10) + '" text-anchor="middle">' + esc(p.label) + '</text>';
  }).join("");
  return '<svg class="dx-chart" viewBox="0 0 ' + W + ' ' + H + '" role="img" aria-label="Your scores over time">' + grid +
    '<path d="' + line + '" fill="none" stroke="#d9b36c" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/>' + dots + '</svg>' +
    '<p class="dx-chart-empty" style="margin-top:8px">The dashed line is the DELF pass mark, 50 out of 100.</p>';
}

function profile(user){
  return '<div class="dx-head"><div class="dx-eyebrow">DELF Dashboard</div><div class="dx-name">' + esc(nameOf(user)) + '</div><div class="dx-email">' + esc(user.email || "") + '</div></div>';
}

function placementCard(st){
  if(!st.attempts || !st.attempts.length){
    return '<div class="dx-card"><div class="dx-label">Your placement</div><p class="dx-empty">No placement result yet. It takes about ten minutes, and your level and scores will appear here.</p></div>';
  }
  var show = st.attempts.filter(function(a){ return a.level === st.highestCleared; })[0] || st.attempts[0];
  var placed = st.highestCleared ? LABEL[st.highestCleared] : "A1";
  var title = st.highestCleared ? "You are placed at " + placed : "You are starting at A1";
  var sub = st.highestCleared ? "You cleared " + placed + " with " + pc(show.pct) + "%. This is your baseline, and every mock exam score lands beside it." :
    "No level cleared yet, which is a perfectly good place to begin.";
  return '<div class="dx-card"><div class="dx-label">Your placement</div><div class="dx-place">' +
    ring(pc(show.pct), 120, 7, st.highestCleared ? placed : "A1", pc(show.pct) + "%") +
    '<div class="dx-place-txt"><h2>' + esc(title) + '</h2><p>' + esc(sub) + '</p><div class="dx-date">' + esc(fmt(show.at)) + '</div></div></div></div>';
}

// marking that is still "pending" long after the test was never started (older tests): call it not marked
function effStatus(a, key){
  var s = a[key];
  if(s === "pending" && a.at && (Date.now() - a.at) > 4 * 60 * 1000) return "ungraded";
  return s;
}

function bar(name, pct, valText, note){
  return '<div><div class="dx-bar-top"><span>' + name + '</span><span><span class="dx-val">' + valText + '</span>' + (note ? ' &middot; ' + note : '') + '</span></div>' +
    '<div class="dx-track"><div class="dx-fill" data-w="' + (pct || 0) + '"></div></div></div>';
}

function skillsCard(st){
  if(!st.attempts || !st.attempts.length) return '<div class="dx-card"><div class="dx-label">Skill by skill</div><p class="dx-empty">Your listening, reading, writing and speaking scores will show here after your placement.</p></div>';
  var show = st.attempts.filter(function(a){ return a.level === st.highestCleared; })[0] || st.attempts[0];
  var lp = show.listening && show.listening.total ? Math.round(show.listening.correct / show.listening.total * 100) : null;
  var rp = show.reading && show.reading.total ? Math.round(show.reading.correct / show.reading.total * 100) : null;
  var ws = effStatus(show, "writing"), ss = effStatus(show, "speaking");
  function open(status, score, name){
    if(status === "graded" && score != null) return bar(name, score, score + "%", "marked");
    var note = status === "pending" ? "marking now" : status === "no_speech" ? "no speech heard" : status === "ungraded" ? "not marked" : "not tried";
    return bar(name, 0, "-", note);
  }
  var h = '<div class="dx-card"><div class="dx-label">Skill by skill</div><div class="dx-bars">' +
    bar("Listening", lp, lp == null ? "-" : lp + "%", "") + bar("Reading", rp, rp == null ? "-" : rp + "%", "") +
    open(ws, show.writingScore, "Writing") + open(ss, show.speakingScore, "Speaking") + '</div>';
  var focus = (lp != null && rp != null && lp !== rp) ? "<b>First focus:</b> " + (lp < rp ? "listening" : "reading") + " is your lowest score, so it will lift your overall result fastest." :
    "<b>First focus:</b> your listening and reading are level, so mix both in your first mock exam.";
  h += '<p class="dx-note">' + focus + '</p>';
  if(show.writingFeedback) h += '<p class="dx-fbk"><b>Writing:</b> ' + esc(show.writingFeedback) + '</p>';
  if(show.speakingFeedback) h += '<p class="dx-fbk"><b>Speaking:</b> ' + esc(show.speakingFeedback) + '</p>';
  return h + '</div>';
}

function mocksCard(st){
  var list = (st.mocks || []).slice().reverse();
  var done = Math.min(list.length, 10), cells = "";
  for(var i = 0; i < 10; i++){
    var m = list[i];
    if(m){ var t = Math.round(m.total || 0); cells += '<div class="dx-mock dx-done' + (t >= 50 ? ' dx-pass' : '') + '"><b>' + t + '</b><span>Mock ' + (i + 1) + '</span></div>'; }
    else cells += '<div class="dx-mock"><b>-</b><span>Mock ' + (i + 1) + '</span></div>';
  }
  var msg = done ? "You have completed <b>" + done + " of 10</b> mock exams, scored the way the real DELF is scored." : "Ten full mock exams, scored the way the real DELF is scored. Your results will appear here one by one.";
  return '<div class="dx-card dx-wide"><div class="dx-label">Mock exams</div><p class="dx-mock-line">' + msg + '</p><div class="dx-mocks">' + cells + '</div></div>';
}

function ctaCard(st){
  if(st.state === "enrolled"){
    return '<div class="dx-card dx-wide dx-cta"><div><h3>Continue Your Preparation</h3><p>' +
      (st.mocks && st.mocks.length ? "Your next mock exam is ready when you are." : "Your first mock exam is waiting. Take it when you feel ready.") +
      '</p></div><button class="dx-btn" onclick="location.href=\'/delf/tout-public/\'">Continue</button></div>';
  }
  if(!st.attempts || !st.attempts.length){
    return '<div class="dx-card dx-wide dx-cta"><div><h3>Start with your placement</h3><p>About ten minutes. You will see your level and your scores right here.</p></div>' +
      '<button class="dx-btn" onclick="location.href=\'/delf/placement.html\'">Start Your Placement</button></div>';
  }
  return '<div class="dx-card dx-wide dx-cta"><div><h3>Begin Your Preparation</h3><p>You placed at ' + (st.highestCleared ? LABEL[st.highestCleared] : "A1") + '. Next stop: DELF ' + LABEL[st.targetExam] +
    '. Forty structured lessons and ten full mock exams, all tracked here. <span id="dxPrice"></span></p></div>' +
    '<button class="dx-btn" onclick="location.href=\'/delf/payment.html?exam=' + encodeURIComponent(st.targetExam) + '\'">Begin Your Preparation</button></div>';
}

var pollsLeft = 8;
function hasPending(st){ return (st.attempts || []).slice(0, 2).some(function(a){ return effStatus(a, "writing") === "pending" || effStatus(a, "speaking") === "pending"; }); }

function paint(user, st){
  try{ if(st && (st.state !== "new" || (st.attempts && st.attempts.length))){ localStorage.setItem("saybon_delf_returning","1"); } }catch(e){}
  if(st.state === "new" && (!st.attempts || !st.attempts.length)){ location.replace("/delf/?landing=1"); return; }
  var pts = [];
  if(st.attempts && st.attempts.length){
    var base = st.attempts.filter(function(a){ return a.level === st.highestCleared; })[0] || st.attempts[0];
    pts.push({ v: pc(base.pct), label: "Placement", kind: "base" });
  }
  (st.mocks || []).slice().reverse().forEach(function(m, i){ pts.push({ v: Math.round(m.total || 0), label: "Mock " + (i + 1), kind: "mock" }); });

  var out = profile(user) + '<div class="dx-grid">' + placementCard(st) + skillsCard(st) + ctaCard(st) +
    '<div class="dx-card dx-wide"><div class="dx-label">Your progress</div>' + chart(pts) + '</div>' + mocksCard(st) + '</div>';
  root.innerHTML = out;
  animateRings();
  if(hasPending(st) && pollsLeft-- > 0){ setTimeout(function(){ refresh(user); }, 8000); }
  if(st.state !== "enrolled" && st.attempts && st.attempts.length && st.targetExam){
    fetch(API_BASE + "/api/delf/prices").then(function(r){ return r.ok ? r.json() : null; }).then(function(d){ var it = d && (d.items || []).filter(function(i){ return i.exam === st.targetExam; })[0];
      var el = document.getElementById("dxPrice"); if(el && it) el.textContent = "One payment of $" + it.usd + (it.ghs ? " (about GH\u20B5" + it.ghs + ")" : "") + ".";
    }).catch(function(){});
  }
}

function anonPrompt(){
  root.innerHTML = '<div class="dx-card"><div class="dx-label">DELF Dashboard</div><p class="dx-empty">You are not logged in to your SayBon account on this device, so we cannot show your results. Log in and your dashboard will be waiting.</p><br><button class="dx-btn" id="dxRelog">Log In</button></div>';
  document.getElementById("dxRelog").onclick = function(){ signOut(auth).catch(function(){}).then(function(){ location.href = "/auth/login.html"; }); };
}
function loginPrompt(){
  root.innerHTML = '<div class="dx-card"><div class="dx-label">DELF Dashboard</div><p class="dx-empty">Log in and your DELF dashboard will be waiting for you here.</p><br><button class="dx-btn" onclick="location.href=\'/auth/login.html\'">Log In</button></div>';
}
function warming(code){
  root.innerHTML = '<div class="dx-card"><div class="dx-label">DELF Dashboard</div><p class="dx-empty">We are warming things up. Give it a moment and refresh, and your results will be right here.' + (code ? ' <small>(Error: ' + esc(code) + ')</small>' : '') + '</p></div>';
}

// the server may be waking up (free hosting), so try a few times before giving up
function getState(token, tries){
  return fetch(API_BASE + "/api/delf/state", { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer " + token } }).then(function(r){
    if(r.ok) return r.json();
    if(tries > 1 && (r.status >= 500 || r.status === 404 || r.status === 429)){
      return new Promise(function(res){ setTimeout(res, 6000); }).then(function(){ return getState(token, tries - 1); });
    }
    var e = new Error(String(r.status)); e.code = r.status; throw e;
  }, function(err){
    if(tries > 1) return new Promise(function(res){ setTimeout(res, 6000); }).then(function(){ return getState(token, tries - 1); });
    throw err;
  });
}

function refresh(user){
  return user.getIdToken().then(function(t){ return getState(t, 9); }).then(function(st){
    st.attempts = st.attempts || []; st.mocks = st.mocks || [];
    paint(user, st);
  });
}

onAuthStateChanged(auth, function(user){
  if(!user){ loginPrompt(); return; }
  if(user.isAnonymous && !user.email){ anonPrompt(); return; }
  refresh(user).catch(function(err){
    console.error("DELF state:", err);
    warming(err && err.code);
  });
});

(function(){
  var content = document.getElementById("dfContent");
  var heroBtn = document.getElementById("dfToggleBtn");

  function toggle(){
    var isOpen = content.classList.toggle("df-open");
    heroBtn.textContent = isOpen ? "Show Less" : "Learn Everything About This Service";
    if(isOpen){
      setTimeout(function(){
        content.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
      }, 150);
    }
  }

  heroBtn.addEventListener("click", toggle);
})();

/* ---------- objective papers ---------- */
function qHtml(q, ex) {
  const k = q.id; let h = '<div class="mk-q">' + esc(q.q) + "</div>";
  if (q.type === "fill") return h + '<input class="mk-fill" data-q="' + k + '" value="' + esc(S.answers[k] || "") + '" autocomplete="off" placeholder="Votre réponse">';
  q.opts.forEach((o, i) => { const sel = S.answers[k] === i; const lab = typeof o === "object" ? '<span class="em">' + esc(o.e) + "</span><span>" + esc(o.t) + "</span>" : "<span>" + esc(o) + "</span>"; h += '<div class="mk-opt ' + (sel ? "sel" : "") + '" data-q="' + k + '" data-i="' + i + '">' + lab + "</div>"; });
  return h;
}
function docHtml(d) { return '<div class="mk-doc"><div class="dh">' + esc(d.title) + "</div>" + esc(d.body) + "</div>"; }
function runObj(k) {
  setBar(S.sec); const part = S.mock[k], sp = S.mock.spec;
  let h = steps() + '<div id="mkBody">';
  part.exercises.forEach(ex => {
    h += '<div class="mk-card"><h2>' + esc(ex.title) + '</h2><p class="mk-instr">' + esc(ex.instr) + "</p>";
    if (k === "co") h += '<div class="mk-play" data-ex="' + ex.id + '"><button class="mk-btn" data-play="' + ex.id + '">▶ Play</button><div class="mk-wave"><i></i></div><span class="cnt">Plays left: <b>' + (ex.plays || 2) + "</b></span></div>";
    else (ex.docs || []).forEach(d => h += docHtml(d));
    ex.questions.forEach(q => h += qHtml(q, ex)); h += "</div>";
  });
  h += '</div><div class="mk-row"><button class="mk-btn" id="mkNext">Submit this paper</button></div>';
  root.innerHTML = h;
  if (k === "co") part.exercises.forEach(ex => { const a = prepAudio(ex); paintPlay(ex); a.promise.then(() => paintPlay(ex)); });
  root.onclick = e => {
    const o = e.target.closest(".mk-opt"); if (o) { S.answers[o.dataset.q] = +o.dataset.i; o.parentNode.querySelectorAll(".mk-opt[data-q='" + o.dataset.q + "']").forEach(x => x.classList.remove("sel")); o.classList.add("sel"); }
    const p = e.target.closest("[data-play]"); if (p) play(part.exercises.find(x => x.id === p.dataset.play), p);
  };
  root.oninput = e => { if (e.target.classList.contains("mk-fill")) S.answers[e.target.dataset.q] = e.target.value; };
  document.getElementById("mkNext").onclick = () => { if (!S.timed || confirm("Submit this paper? You cannot come back to it.")) { score(k); next(); } };
  startTimer(sp[k], () => { score(k); next(); });
}
function score(k) {
  const part = S.mock[k]; let got = 0; const review = [];
  part.exercises.forEach(ex => ex.questions.forEach(q => {
    const a = S.answers[q.id]; let ok = false;
    if (q.type === "fill") ok = q.accepted.some(x => norm(x) === norm(a)); else ok = a === q.ans;
    if (ok) got += q.w; review.push({ ex, q, a, ok });
  }));
  S.results[k] = { raw: got, total: part.totalW, score: part.totalW ? Math.round((got / part.totalW) * 25 * 10) / 10 : 0, review };
}

/* ---------- listening audio (server voices, fetched ahead so it plays on iPhone) ---------- */
const AUDIO = {};
function voiceFor(v) {
  const vs = (speechSynthesis.getVoices() || []).filter(x => /^fr/i.test(x.lang)); const pick = i => vs.length ? vs[i % vs.length] : null;
  return v === "F" ? { voice: pick(0), pitch: 1.2, rate: .88 } : v === "H" ? { voice: pick(1), pitch: .8, rate: .88 } : { voice: pick(0), pitch: 1, rate: .92 };
}
function stopAudio() { if (S.audioEl) { try { S.audioEl.pause(); } catch (e) { } S.audioEl = null; } }
function prepAudio(ex, force) {
  const key = S.mock.id + "|" + ex.id; if (AUDIO[key] && !force) return AUDIO[key];
  const a = AUDIO[key] = { state: "loading", url: null };
  a.promise = (async () => {
    const tk = await token(); if (!tk) throw new Error("login");
    const r = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/delf/tts-lines", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", Authorization: "Bearer " + tk }, body: JSON.stringify({ lines: ex.audio.lines, level: S.mock.level }) });
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(String(r.status));
    a.url = URL.createObjectURL(await r.blob()); a.state = "ready";
  })().catch(() => { a.state = "error"; });
  return a;
}
function paintPlay(ex) {
  const a = AUDIO[S.mock.id + "|" + ex.id]; const box = root.querySelector('.mk-play[data-ex="' + ex.id + '"]'); if (!box || !a) return;
  const btn = box.querySelector("button"), left = +box.querySelector("b").textContent;
  if (a.state === "loading") { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = "Preparing audio…"; }
  else if (a.state === "error") { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = "Audio did not load. Tap to retry"; }
  else { btn.disabled = left <= 0; btn.textContent = left <= 0 ? "Finished" : (left < (ex.plays || 2) ? "▶ Play again" : "▶ Play"); }
}
function play(ex, btn) {
  const box = btn.closest(".mk-play"); const cnt = box.querySelector("b"); let left = +cnt.textContent;
  const a = AUDIO[S.mock.id + "|" + ex.id];
  if (!a || a.state === "error") { prepAudio(ex, true).promise.then(() => paintPlay(ex)); paintPlay(ex); return; }
  if (a.state !== "ready" || left <= 0) return;
  stopAudio(); left--; cnt.textContent = left; btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = "Playing…";
  const bar = box.querySelector("i"); bar.style.width = "0";
  const au = new Audio(a.url); S.audioEl = au;
  au.ontimeupdate = () => { if (au.duration) bar.style.width = Math.round(au.currentTime / au.duration * 100) + "%"; };
  const done = () => { bar.style.width = "100%"; paintPlay(ex); };
  au.onended = done; au.onerror = () => { left++; cnt.textContent = left; a.state = "error"; paintPlay(ex); };
  au.play().catch(() => { left++; cnt.textContent = left; paintPlay(ex); });
}

/* ---------- writing ---------- */
const ACC = ["é", "è", "ê", "à", "â", "ç", "î", "ï", "ô", "ù", "û", "œ", "«", "»"];
function runPE() {
  setBar(S.sec); const tasks = S.mock.pe.tasks; let h = steps();
  tasks.forEach(t => {
    h += '<div class="mk-card"><h2>' + esc(t.title) + '</h2>' + (t.docs || []).map(docHtml).join("") + '<p class="mk-instr">' + esc(t.instr) + "</p>";
    if (t.type === "form") t.fields.forEach(f => h += '<div class="mk-field"><label>' + esc(f.l) + '</label><input class="mk-fill pe-f" data-t="' + t.id + '" data-k="' + f.k + '"></div>');
    else h += '<div class="mk-acc">' + ACC.map(c => '<button type="button" data-ch="' + c + '">' + c + "</button>").join("") + '</div><textarea class="mk-ta pe-t" data-t="' + t.id + '" placeholder="Écrivez ici…"></textarea><div class="mk-wc" data-wc="' + t.id + '">0 / ' + t.min + " words minimum</div>";
    h += "</div>";
  });
  h += '<div class="mk-row"><button class="mk-btn" id="mkNext">Submit for marking</button></div>';
  root.innerHTML = h; let last = null;
  root.onfocusin = e => { if (e.target.matches("textarea,input")) last = e.target; };
  root.onclick = e => { const b = e.target.closest("[data-ch]"); if (b && last) { const s = last.selectionStart; last.value = last.value.slice(0, s) + b.dataset.ch + last.value.slice(last.selectionEnd); last.focus(); last.selectionStart = last.selectionEnd = s + 1; last.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true })); } };
  root.oninput = e => { const el = e.target; if (el.classList.contains("pe-t")) { const t = tasks.find(x => x.id === el.dataset.t), n = words(el.value), w = root.querySelector('[data-wc="' + t.id + '"]'); w.textContent = n + " / " + t.min + " words minimum"; w.classList.toggle("ok", n >= t.min); } };
  const submit = () => { tasks.forEach(t => { if (t.type === "form") { const o = {}; root.querySelectorAll('.pe-f[data-t="' + t.id + '"]').forEach(i => o[i.dataset.k] = i.value); S.pe[t.id] = o; } else S.pe[t.id] = root.querySelector('.pe-t[data-t="' + t.id + '"]').value; }); next(); };
  document.getElementById("mkNext").onclick = () => { if (!S.timed || confirm("Submit your writing?")) submit(); };
  startTimer(S.mock.spec.pe, submit);
}

/* ---------- speaking ---------- */
function lsToWav(blob) {
  return blob.arrayBuffer().then(buf => { const Ctx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext; const c = new Ctx(); return c.decodeAudioData(buf).finally(() => { try { c.close(); } catch (e) { } }); }).then(ab => {
    const len = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(ab.duration * 16000)); const oc = new OfflineAudioContext(1, len, 16000); const src = oc.createBufferSource(); src.buffer = ab; src.connect(oc.destination); src.start(0); return oc.startRendering();
  }).then(r => {
    const d = r.getChannelData(0), n = d.length, out = new DataView(new ArrayBuffer(44 + n * 2)); const w = (o, s) => { for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) out.setUint8(o + i, s.charCodeAt(i)); };
    w(0, "RIFF"); out.setUint32(4, 36 + n * 2, true); w(8, "WAVE"); w(12, "fmt "); out.setUint32(16, 16, true); out.setUint16(20, 1, true); out.setUint16(22, 1, true); out.setUint32(24, 16000, true); out.setUint32(28, 32000, true); out.setUint16(32, 2, true); out.setUint16(34, 16, true); w(36, "data"); out.setUint32(40, n * 2, true);
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const s = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, d[i])); out.setInt16(44 + i * 2, s < 0 ? s * 0x8000 : s * 0x7fff, true); } return new Blob([out], { type: "audio/wav" });
  });
}
function speak(t, cb) {
  if (!("speechSynthesis" in window)) return cb && cb(); try { speechSynthesis.cancel(); } catch (e) { }
  const u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(t); u.lang = "fr-FR"; const vp = voiceFor("F"); if (vp.voice) u.voice = vp.voice; u.rate = .9; u.onend = () => cb && cb(); u.onerror = () => cb && cb(); speechSynthesis.speak(u);
}
function runPO() {
  setBar(S.sec); const sp = S.mock.spec, parts = S.mock.po.parts;
  if (sp.prep && S.timed) {
    root.innerHTML = steps() + '<div class="mk-card"><h2>Preparation time</h2><p class="mk-instr">In the real exam you have ' + sp.prep + ' minutes to prepare. Look at the role-play card below, then continue when ready.</p>' + parts.filter(p => p.card).map(p => '<div class="mk-ex"><b>' + esc(p.title) + "</b><br>" + esc(p.card.instr) + (p.card.words ? "<br>" + p.card.words.map(esc).join(" · ") : "") + (p.card.doc ? '<div class="mk-doc">' + esc(p.card.doc) + "</div>" : "") + "</div>").join("") + '<div class="mk-row"><button class="mk-btn" id="mkNext">I am ready</button></div></div>';
    startTimer(sp.prep, () => poParts(parts)); document.getElementById("mkNext").onclick = () => poParts(parts); return;
  }
  poParts(parts);
}
function poParts(parts) {
  clearInterval(S.timer); const el = document.getElementById("mkTimer"); if (el) el.textContent = ""; S.po = { turns: [] };
  let pi = 0, ti = 0;
  const show = () => {
    const p = parts[pi], t = p.turns[ti]; const last = pi === parts.length - 1 && ti === p.turns.length - 1;
    root.innerHTML = steps() + '<div class="mk-card"><p class="mk-small">Part ' + (pi + 1) + " of " + parts.length + " · turn " + (ti + 1) + " of " + p.turns.length + "</p><h2>" + esc(p.title) + "</h2>" +
      (p.card ? '<div class="mk-ex">' + esc(p.card.instr) + (p.card.words ? "<br><b>" + p.card.words.map(esc).join(" · ") + "</b>" : "") + "</div>" + (p.card.doc ? '<div class="mk-doc">' + esc(p.card.doc) + "</div>" : "") : "") +
      '<div class="mk-says"><b>Examiner:</b> ' + esc(t.ex) + '</div><div class="mk-row"><button class="mk-btn ghost" id="mkRepeat">🔊 Hear again</button></div>' + (t.hint ? '<p class="mk-hint">' + esc(t.hint) + "</p>" : "") +
      '<button class="mk-rec" id="mkRec" aria-label="Record">🎙</button><p class="mk-small" style="text-align:center" id="mkSt">Tap to answer, tap again to stop. For a long answer you can record several times.</p><div id="mkTr"></div>' +
      '<div class="mk-row"><button class="mk-btn ghost" id="mkClear">Clear</button><button class="mk-btn ghost" id="mkType">Type instead</button><button class="mk-btn" id="mkNx" disabled>' + (last ? "Finish speaking" : "Next") + "</button></div></div>";
    let answer = "", rec = null, chunks = [], stream = null, auto = null;
    const setAns = a => { answer = a; document.getElementById("mkTr").innerHTML = a ? '<div class="mk-says"><b>You:</b> ' + esc(a) + "</div>" : ""; document.getElementById("mkNx").disabled = !a; };
    document.getElementById("mkRepeat").onclick = () => speak(t.ex);
    document.getElementById("mkClear").onclick = () => { setAns(""); };
    document.getElementById("mkType").onclick = () => { const a = prompt("Type your answer in French"); if (a) setAns((answer ? answer + " " : "") + a.trim()); };
    document.getElementById("mkRec").onclick = async function () {
      const b = this, st = document.getElementById("mkSt");
      if (rec && rec.state === "recording") { clearTimeout(auto); rec.stop(); return; }
      try { stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true }); } catch (e) { st.textContent = "Microphone not available. Use “Type instead”."; return; }
      chunks = []; rec = new MediaRecorder(stream); rec.ondataavailable = ev => chunks.push(ev.data);
      rec.onstop = async () => {
        b.classList.remove("on"); stream.getTracks().forEach(x => x.stop()); st.textContent = "Listening to your answer…";
        try {
          const wav = await lsToWav(new Blob(chunks, { type: rec.mimeType || "audio/webm" }));
          const r = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/delfTranscribe", { method: "POST", body: wav }); const j = await r.json();
          if (j.error) throw new Error(j.error); if (!j.text) { st.textContent = "I could not hear you clearly. Try again or type."; return; }
          st.textContent = "Got it. Record again to add more, or continue."; setAns(answer ? answer + " " + j.text : j.text);
        } catch (e) { st.textContent = "Could not process the recording. Try again or use “Type instead”."; }
      };
      rec.start(); b.classList.add("on"); st.textContent = "Recording… tap to stop."; auto = setTimeout(() => rec.state === "recording" && rec.stop(), 55000);
    };
    document.getElementById("mkNx").onclick = () => {
      S.po.turns.push({ part: p.title, examiner: t.ex, answer }); try { speechSynthesis.cancel(); } catch (e) { }
      if (ti + 1 < p.turns.length) ti++; else if (pi + 1 < parts.length) { pi++; ti = 0; } else return next(); show();
    };
    speak(t.ex);
  };
  show();
}

/* ---------- results ---------- */
async function gradeAll() {
  const m = S.mock; const out = { pe: [], po: null };
  const docsOf = t => (t.docs || []).length ? "\n\nDOCUMENTS:\n" + t.docs.map(d => d.title + "\n" + d.body).join("\n\n") : "";
  const call = (rubric, responses) => fetch(API_BASE + "/api/gradeDelfMock", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ rubric, responses }) }).then(r => r.json());
  for (const t of m.pe.tasks) {
    const resp = t.type === "form" ? m.pe.tasks.find(x => x.id === t.id).fields.map(f => f.l + ": " + ((S.pe[t.id] || {})[f.k] || "")).join("\n") : (S.pe[t.id] || "");
    try { const g = await call(t.rubric, [{ task: t.instr + docsOf(t), response: resp }]); out.pe.push(Object.assign({ t }, g)); } catch (e) { out.pe.push({ t, error: true }); }
  }
  const tr = S.po.turns || [];
  const src = (m.scheme === "c2" && m.co.exercises[0] ? "\n\nSOUND DOCUMENT (transcript):\n" + m.co.exercises[0].audio.lines.map(l => l.t).join(" ") : "") + m.po.parts.filter(p => p.card && p.card.doc).map(p => "\n\nDOCUMENT:\n" + p.card.doc).join("");
  const poR = tr.map((x, i) => ({ task: (i === 0 ? "Source material for the oral task:" + src + "\n\n" : "") + x.part + " — examiner: " + x.examiner, response: x.answer }));
  try { out.po = await call("po-" + m.level, poR); } catch (e) { out.po = { error: true }; }
  return out;
}
async function finish() {
  if (ONLY) return finishOnly();
  window.__mkBusy = false; setBar(-1); root.onclick = null; root.oninput = null;
  root.innerHTML = '<div class="mk-card"><h2>Marking your writing and speaking…</h2><p class="mk-instr">This takes about half a minute.</p></div>';
  const g = await gradeAll(); const m = S.mock;
  let pe = 0, peMax = 0, ok = true;
  g.pe.forEach(x => { if (x.error || x.max == null) { ok = false; return; } pe += Math.min(1, Math.max(0, x.total / x.max)) * x.t.share; peMax += x.t.share; });
  const SC = m.scheme === "c2" ? 50 : 25;
  const po = g.po && !g.po.error && g.po.max ? Math.min(1, Math.max(0, g.po.total / g.po.max)) * SC : 0; if (!g.po || g.po.error) ok = false;
  S.results.pe = { score: Math.round(pe * 10) / 10, g: g.pe, failed: g.pe.some(x => x.error) }; S.results.po = { score: Math.round(po * 10) / 10, g: g.po };
  const sc = m.scheme === "c2" ? { pe: S.results.pe.score, po: S.results.po.score } : { co: S.results.co.score, ce: S.results.ce.score, pe: S.results.pe.score, po: S.results.po.score };
  const total = Math.round(Object.values(sc).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) * 10) / 10; const pass = total >= 50 && Object.values(sc).every(v => v >= (m.scheme === "c2" ? 10 : 5));
  S.final = { sc, total, pass, ok };
  let saved = null; const tk = await token();
  if (tk && ok) { try { const r = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/delfMockSave", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", Authorization: "Bearer " + tk }, body: JSON.stringify({ mockId: m.id, scores: sc, feedback: { pe: g.pe.map(x => ({ total: x.total, max: x.max, strengths: x.strengths, improvements: x.improvements })), po: g.po && { total: g.po.total, max: g.po.max, strengths: g.po.strengths, improvements: g.po.improvements } }, answers: { co: Object.keys(S.answers).length, pe: S.pe, po: S.po } }) }); saved = (await r.json()).ok; } catch (e) { saved = false; } }
  results(saved);
}
async function finishOnly() {
  window.__mkBusy = false; setBar(-1); root.onclick = null; root.oninput = null;
  const k = ONLY, m = S.mock; let score = 0, ok = true;
  if (k === "co" || k === "ce") { score = S.results[k] ? S.results[k].score : 0; }
  else {
    root.innerHTML = '<div class="mk-card"><h2>Marking your ' + (k === "pe" ? "writing" : "speaking") + '…</h2><p class="mk-instr">This takes about half a minute.</p></div>';
    const g = await gradeAll();
    if (k === "pe") { let pe = 0; g.pe.forEach(x => { if (x.error || x.max == null) { ok = false; return; } pe += Math.min(1, Math.max(0, x.total / x.max)) * x.t.share; }); score = Math.round(pe * 10) / 10; S.results.pe = { score, g: g.pe, failed: g.pe.some(x => x.error) }; }
    else { const po = g.po && !g.po.error && g.po.max ? Math.min(1, Math.max(0, g.po.total / g.po.max)) * 25 : 0; if (!g.po || g.po.error) ok = false; score = Math.round(po * 10) / 10; S.results.po = { score, g: g.po }; }
  }
  S.final = { sc: { [k]: score }, total: score, pass: score >= 12.5, ok, only: true };
  let saved = null; const tk = await token();
  if (tk && ok && JL) { try { const r = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/delf/journey/skill-mock", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", Authorization: "Bearer " + tk }, body: JSON.stringify({ level: JL, skill: k, mockId: m.id, score }) }); saved = (await r.json()).ok === true; } catch (e) { saved = false; } }
  results(saved);
}
function decorateOnly(saved) {
  const f = S.final, pct = Math.round(f.total / 25 * 100), pass = f.total >= 12.5, card = root.querySelector(".mk-card");
  const msg = !f.ok ? "Part of your answer could not be marked (connection problem), so this score is not saved. Please retake it in a moment."
    : pass ? "You are at or above the 50% pass mark for this paper. Well done: you can move on to the next skill."
    : "This is under the 50% pass mark. We strongly recommend the two extra lessons for this skill, which go slowly and explain more. The choice is yours: you can also skip them and move on.";
  card.innerHTML = '<div class="mk-score">' + f.total + '<span style="font-size:1.4rem"> / 25</span></div><p style="margin:6px 0;font-weight:800">' + pct + '%</p><p style="margin:10px 0"><span class="mk-pass ' + (pass && f.ok ? "y" : "n") + '">' + (!f.ok ? "NOT SAVED" : pass ? "ABOVE THE PASS MARK" : "BELOW THE PASS MARK") + '</span></p><p class="mk-small">' + msg + '</p>' +
    (f.ok && saved === true ? '<p class="mk-small">Saved to your journey.</p>' : f.ok && saved === false ? '<p class="mk-small" style="color:var(--bad)">Could not save this result. Please check your connection and retake.</p>' : "");
  root.querySelectorAll(".tabs button").forEach(b => { const k = b.dataset.tab; const keep = (ONLY === "co" || ONLY === "ce") ? k === "rv" : ONLY === "pe" ? k === "wr" : k === "sp"; if (!keep) b.remove(); });
  const row = root.querySelector(".mk-row"); if (row) row.innerHTML = '<button class="mk-btn" onclick="location.href=\'' + BACK + '\'">' + (JL ? "Back to my journey" : "Back") + '</button><button class="mk-btn ghost" onclick="location.reload()">Retake</button>';
}
function results(saved) {
  const f = S.final, m = S.mock;
  const tiles = SECS.filter(s => f.sc[s[0]] != null).map(s => '<div class="mk-tile ' + (f.sc[s[0]] < (m.scheme === "c2" ? 10 : 5) ? "low" : "") + '"><span class="mk-small">' + s[1] + '</span><b>' + f.sc[s[0]] + '</b><span class="mk-small">/ ' + (m.scheme === "c2" ? 50 : 25) + '</span></div>').join("");
  root.innerHTML = '<p class="mk-eyebrow">Your result</p><div class="mk-card" style="text-align:center"><div class="mk-score">' + f.total + '<span style="font-size:1.4rem"> / 100</span></div><p style="margin:10px 0"><span class="mk-pass ' + (f.pass ? "y" : "n") + '">' + (f.pass ? "PASS LEVEL" : "NOT YET") + "</span></p><p class='mk-small'>" + (m.scheme === "c2" ? "Pass mark: 50/100 overall and at least 10/50 in each paper." : "Pass mark: 50/100 overall and at least 5/25 in each paper.") + "</p><div class='mk-grid4'>" + tiles + "</div>" +

  if(isAdmin){
    document.getElementById("pmUnlock").onclick = function(){ adminSet(selected, false); };
    document.getElementById("pmLock").onclick = function(){ var o = items.filter(function(i){ return i.owned && (i.exam === selected || true); }); adminSet((o.filter(function(i){ return i.exam === selected; })[0] || o[0]).exam, true); };
  }
}
function adminSet(exam, lock){
  if(!exam || !currentUser) return;
  document.getElementById("pmStatus").textContent = "Updating...";
  currentUser.getIdToken().then(function(t){
    return fetch(API_BASE + "/api/delf/admin-grant", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", Authorization: "Bearer " + t }, body: JSON.stringify({ exam: exam, lock: lock }) });
  }).then(function(r){ return r.json(); }).then(function(d){
    if(d.ok){ items.forEach(function(i){ if(i.exam === exam) i.owned = !lock; }); if(!lock) selected = null; draw(); document.getElementById("pmStatus").textContent = (lock ? "Locked " : "Unlocked ") + exam.toUpperCase() + ". Open your dashboard to see it."; }
    else document.getElementById("pmStatus").textContent = d.error || "Could not update.";
  }).catch(function(){ document.getElementById("pmStatus").textContent = "Could not reach the server."; });
}

function go(provider){
  var st = document.getElementById("pmStatus"), btns = [document.getElementById("pmCard"), document.getElementById("pmCedi")];
  if(!selected || !currentUser) return;
  btns.forEach(function(b){ b.disabled = true; });
  st.textContent = "Taking you to the secure payment page...";
  currentUser.getIdToken().then(function(t){
    return fetch(API_BASE + "/api/delf/checkout", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", Authorization: "Bearer " + t }, body: JSON.stringify({ exam: selected, provider: provider }) });
  }).then(function(r){ return r.json().then(function(d){ return { ok: r.ok, d: d }; }); }).then(function(x){
    if(x.ok && x.d.url){ location.href = x.d.url; return; }
    st.textContent = (x.d && x.d.error) ? x.d.error.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + x.d.error.slice(1) + "." : "Could not start the payment. Please try again.";
    draw(); document.getElementById("pmStatus").textContent = st.textContent;
  }).catch(function(){ draw(); document.getElementById("pmStatus").textContent = "Could not reach the server. Please try again in a moment."; });
}

function load(token, tries){
  return fetch(API_BASE + "/api/delf/prices", { headers: token ? { Authorization: "Bearer " + token } : {} }).then(function(r){
    if(r.ok) return r.json();
    if(tries > 1) return new Promise(function(res){ setTimeout(res, 5000); }).then(function(){ return load(token, tries - 1); });
    throw new Error(r.status);
  }, function(e){
    if(tries > 1) return new Promise(function(res){ setTimeout(res, 5000); }).then(function(){ return load(token, tries - 1); });
    throw e;
  });
}

onAuthStateChanged(auth, function(user){
  currentUser = user;
  if(!user || (user.isAnonymous && !user.email)){
    body.innerHTML = '<p class="pm-msg">Please log in to your SayBon account to choose a level and pay.</p><button class="pm-btn" onclick="location.href=\'/auth/login.html\'">Log In</button>';
    return;
  }
  user.getIdToken().then(function(t){ return load(t, 8); }).then(function(d){
    items = d.items || []; isAdmin = !!d.admin;
    var free = items.filter(function(i){ return !i.owned; });
    selected = (items.filter(function(i){ return i.exam === wanted && !i.owned; })[0] || free[0] || {}).exam || null;
    draw();
  }).catch(function(){ body.innerHTML = '<p class="pm-msg">We could not load the prices just now. Please refresh in a moment.</p>'; });
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

function buildAccentKeyboard(targetInput){
  var wrap = document.createElement("div");
  wrap.style.display = "flex";
  wrap.style.flexWrap = "wrap";
  wrap.style.gap = "6px";
  wrap.style.marginBottom = "20px";

  accentChars.forEach(function(ch){
    var key = document.createElement("span");
    key.textContent = ch;
    key.style.display = "inline-block";
    key.style.padding = "6px 11px";
    key.style.borderRadius = "7px";
    key.style.cursor = "pointer";
    key.style.background = "rgba(212,175,106,.12)";
    key.style.color = "#d4af6a";
    key.style.fontSize = "15px";
    key.style.border = "1px solid rgba(212,175,106,.25)";
    key.onclick = function(){
      var start = targetInput.selectionStart;
      var end = targetInput.selectionEnd;
      var val = targetInput.value;
      targetInput.value = val.slice(0, start) + ch + val.slice(end);
      targetInput.selectionStart = targetInput.selectionEnd = start + ch.length;
      targetInput.focus();
    };
    wrap.appendChild(key);
  });

  return wrap;
}
