// ---------------- TEST BUILD (shuffle options once per attempt) ----------------

function shuffled(n){
  var a = []; for(var i = 0; i < n; i++) a.push(i);
  for(var j = n - 1; j > 0; j--){ var k = Math.floor(Math.random() * (j + 1)); var t = a[j]; a[j] = a[k]; a[k] = t; }
  return a;
}

function buildSkill(docs, bodyKey){
  var flat = [];
  var built = docs.map(function(d, di){
    var qs = d.questions.map(function(q){
      var order = shuffled(q.options.length);
      var item = { q: q.q, options: order.map(function(o){ return q.options[o]; }), correct: order.indexOf(q.correct), gi: flat.length };
      flat.push(item);
      return item;
    });
    return { title: d.title, body: d[bodyKey], voice: d.voice, questions: qs };
  });
  return { docs: built, flat: flat };
}

function buildTest(levelId){
  var lvl = LEVELS[levelId];
  return { listening: buildSkill(lvl.listening.docs, "script"), reading: buildSkill(lvl.reading.texts, "passage") };
}

function esc(t){ return String(t).replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;"); }

function questionBlock(item, n, skill){
  var answers = skill === "listening" ? state.listeningAnswers : state.readingAnswers;
  var opts = item.options.map(function(opt, oi){
    var sel = "";
    return '<button class="pl-option' + sel + '" data-skill="' + skill + '" data-gi="' + item.gi + '" data-oi="' + oi + '" onclick="' + (skill === "listening" ? "selectListening" : "selectReading") + '(' + item.gi + ',' + oi + ')">' + esc(opt) + '</button>';
  }).join("");
  return '<div class="pl-qblock"><p class="pl-question">' + n + '. ' + esc(item.q) + '</p><div class="pl-options" data-qgi="' + item.gi + '">' + opts + '</div></div>';
}

function allDone(skill){
  var flat = state.built[skill].flat;
  var answers = skill === "listening" ? state.listeningAnswers : state.readingAnswers;
  for(var i = 0; i < flat.length; i++){ if(answers[i] === undefined) return false; }
  return true;
}

function markSelected(skill, gi, oi){
  var flat = state.built[skill].flat;
  var answers = skill === "listening" ? state.listeningAnswers : state.readingAnswers;
  if(gi >= 0){
    var item = flat[gi];
    var btns = document.querySelectorAll('.pl-option[data-skill="' + skill + '"][data-gi="' + gi + '"]');
    for(var i = 0; i < btns.length; i++){
      var idx = Number(btns[i].getAttribute("data-oi"));
      btns[i].disabled = true;
      btns[i].classList.add("pl-locked");
      if(idx === oi) btns[i].classList.add(oi === item.correct ? "pl-correct" : "pl-wrong");
      else if(idx === item.correct && oi !== item.correct) btns[i].classList.add("pl-correct");
    }
  }
  var cont = document.getElementById("plContinue");
  if(cont) cont.disabled = !allDone(skill);
  var left = document.getElementById("plLeft");
  if(left){
    var c = 0;
    for(var k = 0; k < flat.length; k++){ if(answers[k] !== undefined) c++; }
    left.textContent = c + " of " + flat.length + " answered";
  }
}

function audioUrlFor(levelId, docIndex){
  // Uploaded audio is ignored on purpose: every recording is built from the exact script of its own document.
  return null;
}

function renderListening(){
  var lvl = LEVELS[state.currentLevelId];
  var docs = state.built.listening.docs;
  var n = 0;
  state.audio = {};
  var html = docs.map(function(d, di){
    var url = audioUrlFor(state.currentLevelId, di);
    var player;
    if(url){
      player = '<audio controls preload="none" style="width:100%;margin-bottom:14px;" src="' + url + '"></audio>';
    } else {
      var left = 2 - (state.ttsPlays[di] || 0);
      player = '<div class="pl-tts"><button class="pl-btn pl-btn-secondary pl-tts-btn" id="plTts' + di + '" onclick="playListeningDoc(' + di + ')" disabled>Preparing audio...</button>' +
        '<span class="pl-tts-left" id="plTtsLeft' + di + '">' + left + ' ' + (left === 1 ? "play" : "plays") + ' left</span></div>';
    }
    var qs = d.questions.map(function(q){ n++; return questionBlock(q, n, "listening"); }).join("");
    return '<div class="pl-doc"><h3 class="pl-doc-title">Document ' + (di + 1) + ' of ' + docs.length + '</h3>' + player + qs + '</div>';
  }).join("");

  render(
    '<div class="pl-progress-row"><span class="pl-progress-label">Listening</span><span class="pl-progress-level">Level ' + lvl.label + '</span></div>' +
    '<div class="pl-card">' +
    '<span class="pl-skill-pill">Listen &amp; Answer</span>' +
    '<p class="pl-hint">Listen to each document, then answer its questions. You may listen twice.</p>' +
    html +
    '<div class="pl-btn-row"><span class="pl-count" id="plLeft"></span><button class="pl-btn pl-btn-primary" id="plContinue" disabled onclick="renderReading()">Continue to Reading</button></div>' +
    '</div>'
  );
  markSelected("listening", -1, -1);
  docs.forEach(function(d, di){ if(!audioUrlFor(state.currentLevelId, di)) prepareAudio(di); });
}

function ttsSetBtn(di, html, disabled){
  var b = document.getElementById("plTts" + di);
  if(b){ b.innerHTML = html; b.disabled = !!disabled; }
}
function ttsSetLeft(di){
  var left = 2 - (state.ttsPlays[di] || 0);
  var lab = document.getElementById("plTtsLeft" + di);
  if(lab) lab.textContent = left + ' ' + (left === 1 ? "play" : "plays") + ' left';
  return left;
}
function ttsIdle(di){
  var a = state.audio && state.audio[di];
  var left = ttsSetLeft(di);
  if(a && a.status === "failed" && !window.speechSynthesis){ ttsSetBtn(di, "Retry audio", false); return; }
  ttsSetBtn(di, "&#9658; Listen", left <= 0);
}

// Fetch a real French neural-voice recording for this document from the server.
function prepareAudio(di){
  var a = state.audio[di] = { status: "loading", el: null };
  var text = state.built.listening.docs[di].body;
  var levelId = state.currentLevelId;
  var voice = state.built.listening.docs[di].voice || "f";
  var user = auth.currentUser;
  var ctl = (typeof AbortController !== "undefined") ? new AbortController() : null;
  var timer = setTimeout(function(){ if(ctl) ctl.abort(); }, 45000);
  var tokenP = user ? user.getIdToken() : Promise.reject(new Error("not signed in"));
  tokenP.then(function(token){
    return fetch(API_BASE + "/api/delf/tts", {
      method: "POST", signal: ctl ? ctl.signal : undefined,
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": "Bearer " + token },
      body: JSON.stringify({ text: text, level: levelId, voice: voice })
    });
  }).then(function(res){
    if(!res.ok) throw new Error("tts " + res.status);
    return res.blob();
  }).then(function(blob){
    clearTimeout(timer);
    if(!blob || blob.size < 1000) throw new Error("empty audio");
    if(state.audio[di] !== a) return;               // page moved on
    var el = new Audio();
    el.preload = "auto";
    el.src = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    a.el = el; a.status = "ready";
    ttsIdle(di);
  }).catch(function(e){
    clearTimeout(timer);
    console.warn("DELF audio unavailable, using device voice:", e);
    if(state.audio[di] !== a) return;
    a.status = "failed";
    ttsIdle(di);
  });
}

function stopAllListening(){
  try{ if(window.speechSynthesis) window.speechSynthesis.cancel(); }catch(e){}
  var all = state.audio || {};
  Object.keys(all).forEach(function(k){ try{ if(all[k].el){ all[k].el.pause(); } }catch(e){} });
}

function playListeningDoc(di){
  if((state.ttsPlays[di] || 0) >= 2) return;
  var a = state.audio && state.audio[di];
  if(!a) return;
  if(a.status === "failed" && !window.speechSynthesis){ prepareAudio(di); ttsSetBtn(di, "Preparing audio...", true); return; }
  stopAllListening();
  var counted = false;
  var count = function(){
    if(counted) return; counted = true;
    state.ttsPlays[di] = (state.ttsPlays[di] || 0) + 1;
    ttsSetLeft(di);
    ttsSetBtn(di, "Playing...", true);
  };
  var finish = function(){ ttsIdle(di); };
  var problem = function(){ if(!counted){ ttsSetBtn(di, "&#9658; Listen again", false); } else { finish(); } };

  if(a.status === "ready" && a.el){
    var el = a.el;
    el.onplaying = count; el.onended = finish; el.onerror = problem;
    try{ el.currentTime = 0; }catch(e){}
    var p = el.play();
    if(p && p.catch){ p.catch(function(){ problem(); }); }
    return;
  }

  // Fallback: the device's own voice (only if the server audio could not be loaded).
  if(!window.speechSynthesis){ problem(); return; }
  var text = state.built.listening.docs[di].body.replace(/(^|\s)[–—-]\s/g, "$1");
  var u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
  u.lang = "fr-FR"; u.rate = 0.85;
  var voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices();
  for(var i = 0; i < voices.length; i++){ if(voices[i].lang && voices[i].lang.toLowerCase().replace("_","-").indexOf("fr") === 0){ u.voice = voices[i]; break; } }
  var done = false;
  var end = function(){ if(done) return; done = true; clearTimeout(starter); clearTimeout(cap); finish(); };
  u.onstart = count; u.onend = end;
  u.onerror = function(){ if(done) return; done = true; clearTimeout(starter); clearTimeout(cap); problem(); };
  var starter = setTimeout(function(){ if(!counted && !done){ done = true; try{ window.speechSynthesis.cancel(); }catch(e){} problem(); } }, 6000);
  var cap = setTimeout(end, 180000);
  window.speechSynthesis.speak(u);
}

function selectListening(gi, oi){

  state.listeningAnswers[gi] = oi;
  markSelected("listening", gi, oi);
}

var plAudioCtx = null;
var plWaveAnimId = null;

function startWave(streamOrElement, isElement){
  var canvas = document.getElementById("plWaveCanvas");
  var ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  canvas.style.display = "block";
  if(!plAudioCtx){
    plAudioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
  }
  var analyser = plAudioCtx.createAnalyser();
  analyser.fftSize = 64;

  if(isElement){
    if(!streamOrElement._plWaveSource){
      streamOrElement._plWaveSource = plAudioCtx.createMediaElementSource(streamOrElement);
      streamOrElement._plWaveSource.connect(plAudioCtx.destination);
    }
    streamOrElement._plWaveSource.connect(analyser);
  } else {
    var source = plAudioCtx.createMediaStreamSource(streamOrElement);
    source.connect(analyser);
  }

  var bufferLength = analyser.frequencyBinCount;
  var dataArray = new Uint8Array(bufferLength);

  function draw(){
    plWaveAnimId = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    var barWidth = (canvas.width / bufferLength) * 1.8;
    var x = 0;
    for(var i = 0; i < bufferLength; i++){
      var barHeight = (dataArray[i] / 255) * canvas.height;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#d4af6a";
      ctx.fillRect(x, canvas.height - barHeight, barWidth, barHeight);
      x += barWidth + 2;
    }
  }
  draw();
}

function stopWave(){
  if(plWaveAnimId){
    cancelAnimationFrame(plWaveAnimId);
    plWaveAnimId = null;
  }
  var canvas = document.getElementById("plWaveCanvas");
  if(canvas){
    canvas.getContext("2d").clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    canvas.style.display = "none";
  }
}

function playRecording(){
  var playBtn = document.getElementById("plPlayBtn");
  var audioEl = document.getElementById("plPlaybackAudio");
  var originalLabel = playBtn.innerHTML;
  playBtn.innerHTML = '<span class="pl-loading-pulse"></span>Loading...';
  playBtn.disabled = true;

  audioEl.src = URL.createObjectURL(state.speakingBlob);

  var onReady = function(){
    playBtn.innerHTML = originalLabel;
    playBtn.disabled = false;
    startWave(audioEl, true);
    audioEl.currentTime = 0;
    audioEl.play();
  };

  audioEl.addEventListener("canplay", onReady, { once: true });
  audioEl.addEventListener("ended", stopWave, { once: true });
}

function reRecordSpeaking(){
  state.speakingBlob = null;
  document.getElementById("plPlaybackRow").style.display = "none";
  var btn = document.getElementById("plRecordBtn");
  btn.style.display = "inline-block";
  btn.textContent = "● Record";
  btn.classList.remove("pl-recording");
  document.getElementById("plRecordStatus").textContent = "Not recorded yet";
}

function toggleRecording(){
  var btn = document.getElementById("plRecordBtn");
  var status = document.getElementById("plRecordStatus");

  if(!mediaRecorder || mediaRecorder.state === "inactive"){
    navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true }).then(function(stream){
      currentStream = stream;
      recordedChunks = [];
      mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
      mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = function(e){ recordedChunks.push(e.data); };
      mediaRecorder.onstop = function(){ if(window.resumeAppBgMusicAfterRecording){ window.resumeAppBgMusicAfterRecording(); }
        state.speakingBlob = new Blob(recordedChunks, { type: "audio/webm" });
        stopWave();
        document.getElementById("plRecordBtn").style.display = "none";
        document.getElementById("plPlaybackRow").style.display = "flex";
        currentStream.getTracks().forEach(function(t){ t.stop(); });
      };
      if(window.pauseAppBgMusicForRecording){ window.pauseAppBgMusicForRecording(); } mediaRecorder.start();
      startWave(stream, false);
      btn.textContent = "■ Stop";
      btn.classList.add("pl-recording");
      status.textContent = "Recording...";
    }).catch(function(err){
      status.textContent = "Microphone access denied";
      console.error(err);
    });
  } else {
    mediaRecorder.stop();
  }
}

// ---------------- SCORING + LEVEL RESULT ----------------

function scoreLevel(){
  var lq = state.built.listening.flat, rq = state.built.reading.flat;
  var lc = 0, rc = 0;
  lq.forEach(function(item, i){ if(state.listeningAnswers[i] === item.correct) lc++; });
  rq.forEach(function(item, i){ if(state.readingAnswers[i] === item.correct) rc++; });
  var total = lq.length + rq.length, correct = lc + rc;
  return { correct: correct, total: total, pct: correct / total,
    listening: { correct: lc, total: lq.length },
    reading: { correct: rc, total: rq.length } };
}

function finishLevel(){
  var result = scoreLevel();
  var passed = result.pct >= PASS_THRESHOLD;
  var lvl = LEVELS[state.currentLevelId];

  if(passed) state.clearedLevels.push(state.currentLevelId);

  state.pending = state.pending || [];
  state.pending.push(saveResultToFirestore(state.currentLevelId, result, passed));

  var nextIdx = LEVEL_ORDER.indexOf(state.currentLevelId) + 1;
  var nextLevelId = LEVEL_ORDER[nextIdx];
  var canClimb = passed && nextLevelId && LEVELS[nextLevelId].hasContent;
  var nextLevelExistsButLocked = passed && nextLevelId && !LEVELS[nextLevelId].hasContent;

  var pctDisplay = Math.round(result.pct * 100);

  var msg, buttons;

  if(passed && canClimb){
    msg = "Well done - you cleared " + lvl.label + " with " + pctDisplay + "%. Let's see how you do at " + LEVELS[nextLevelId].label + ".";
    buttons = '<div class="pl-btn-row">' +
      '<button class="pl-btn pl-btn-secondary" onclick="finalizeResult()">Stop Here</button>' +
      '<button class="pl-btn pl-btn-primary" onclick="startLevel(\'' + nextLevelId + '\')">Try ' + LEVELS[nextLevelId].label + '</button>' +
      '</div>';
  } else if(passed && nextLevelExistsButLocked){
    msg = "Well done - you cleared " + lvl.label + " with " + pctDisplay + "%. The next level's content is still being added, so this is where your placement stands for now.";
    buttons = '<div class="pl-btn-row"><button class="pl-btn pl-btn-primary" onclick="finalizeResult()">Go to My Dashboard</button></div>';
  } else if(passed && !nextLevelId){
    msg = "Excellent - you cleared " + lvl.label + " with " + pctDisplay + "%, the highest level we currently test.";
    buttons = '<div class="pl-btn-row"><button class="pl-btn pl-btn-primary" onclick="finalizeResult()">Go to My Dashboard</button></div>';
  } else {
    msg = "You scored " + pctDisplay + "% at " + lvl.label + " - just under our 70% threshold to climb further. That's completely alright, and this gives us an honest picture of where to begin.";
    buttons = '<div class="pl-btn-row"><button class="pl-btn pl-btn-primary" onclick="finalizeResult()">Go to My Dashboard</button></div>';
  }

  render(
    '<div class="pl-card">' +
    '<div class="pl-result-score">' + pctDisplay + '%</div>' +
    '<p class="pl-result-msg">' + msg + '</p>' +
    buttons +
    '</div>'
  );
}

function finalizeResult(){
  render(
    '<p class="pl-eyebrow">Almost there</p>' +
    '<h1 class="pl-title">Preparing your dashboard</h1>' +
    '<p class="pl-subtitle">Saving your results and marking your writing and speaking. This takes a few seconds.</p>'
  );
  var gone = false;
  var go = function(){ if(gone) return; gone = true; location.href = "/delf/dashboard.html"; };
  var timer = setTimeout(go, 45000);
  Promise.all(state.pending || []).then(function(){ clearTimeout(timer); go(); }, function(){ clearTimeout(timer); go(); });
}

// ---------------- FIRESTORE SAVE + MARKING ----------------

function encodeWAV(samples, sampleRate){
  var buffer = new ArrayBuffer(44 + samples.length * 2);
  var view = new DataView(buffer);
  function writeString(offset, str){ for(var i = 0; i < str.length; i++) view.setUint8(offset + i, str.charCodeAt(i)); }
  writeString(0, "RIFF"); view.setUint32(4, 36 + samples.length * 2, true); writeString(8, "WAVE"); writeString(12, "fmt ");
  view.setUint32(16, 16, true); view.setUint16(20, 1, true); view.setUint16(22, 1, true);
  view.setUint32(24, sampleRate, true); view.setUint32(28, sampleRate * 2, true); view.setUint16(32, 2, true); view.setUint16(34, 16, true);
  writeString(36, "data"); view.setUint32(40, samples.length * 2, true);
  var offset = 44;
  for(var i = 0; i < samples.length; i++, offset += 2){
    var s = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, samples[i]));
    view.setInt16(offset, s < 0 ? s * 0x8000 : s * 0x7FFF, true);
  }
  return buffer;
}

// the browser records webm/mp4; the speech service needs 16 kHz mono WAV
async function blobToWav(blob){
  var arrayBuffer = await blob.arrayBuffer();
  var audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
  var decoded = await audioCtx.decodeAudioData(arrayBuffer);
  var offlineCtx = new OfflineAudioContext(1, Math.ceil(decoded.duration * 16000), 16000);
  var source = offlineCtx.createBufferSource();
  source.buffer = decoded; source.connect(offlineCtx.destination); source.start(0);
  var rendered = await offlineCtx.startRendering();
  var wav = encodeWAV(rendered.getChannelData(0), 16000);
  try{ audioCtx.close(); }catch(e){}
  return new Blob([wav], { type: "audio/wav" });
}

function saveResultToFirestore(levelId, result, passed){
  if(!auth.currentUser){
    console.warn("Not saving placement result - no authenticated user");
    return Promise.resolve();
  }
  var user = auth.currentUser;
  var speakingBlob = state.speakingBlob;
  var writingText = state.writingText || "";
  var lvl = LEVELS[levelId];
  return user.getIdToken().then(function(token){
    return fetch(API_BASE + "/api/delf/placement", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": "Bearer " + token },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        level: levelId,
        listening: result.listening,
        reading: result.reading,
        writingResponse: writingText || null,
        speakingRecorded: !!speakingBlob
      })
    }).then(function(res){
      if(!res.ok) throw new Error("save failed " + res.status);
      return res.json();
    }).then(function(saved){
      var jobs = [];
      if(saved && saved.id){
        if(writingText.trim()){
          jobs.push(fetch(API_BASE + "/api/delf/grade-writing", {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": "Bearer " + token },
            body: JSON.stringify({ attemptId: saved.id, level: levelId, prompt: lvl.writing.prompt })
          }));
        }
        if(speakingBlob){
          jobs.push(blobToWav(speakingBlob).then(function(wav){
            return fetch(API_BASE + "/api/delf/grade-speaking?attemptId=" + encodeURIComponent(saved.id) + "&level=" + encodeURIComponent(levelId) + "&prompt=" + encodeURIComponent(lvl.speaking.prompt), {
              method: "POST",
              headers: { "Content-Type": "audio/wav", "Authorization": "Bearer " + token },
              body: wav
            });
          }));
        }
      }
      return Promise.all(jobs.map(function(j){ return j.catch(function(e){ console.warn("marking request failed:", e); }); }));
    });
  }).catch(function(err){
    console.error("Could not save placement result:", err);
  });
}

}

function show() {
  const b = S.lesson.blocks[S.i]; let h = head() + teacherHtml(b);
  h += (b.tidbit ? '<div class="cs-tip"><b>Tidbit.</b> ' + esc(b.tidbit) + '</div>' : "");
  if (b.type === "teach") {
    h += '<div class="cs-card"><div class="cs-h">' + esc(b.title) + '</div>' + (b.paras || []).map(p => '<p class="cs-p">' + esc(p) + '</p>').join("") +
      (b.points ? '<ul class="cs-ul">' + b.points.map(p => '<li>' + esc(p) + '</li>').join("") + '</ul>' : "") +
      (b.tip ? '<div class="cs-tip"><b>Tip.</b> ' + esc(b.tip) + '</div>' : "") + '</div><button class="cs-btn" id="nx">Continue</button>';
  } else if (b.type === "vocab") {
    h += '<div class="cs-card"><div class="cs-h">' + esc(b.title) + '</div>' + b.items.map(x => '<div class="cs-voc"><b>' + esc(x[0]) + '</b><span>' + esc(x[1]) + '</span></div>').join("") + (b.note ? '<p class="cs-note">' + esc(b.note) + '</p>' : "") + '</div><button class="cs-btn" id="nx">Continue</button>';
  } else if (b.type === "listen") { h += listenHtml(b); }
  else if (b.type === "recap") {
    h += '<div class="cs-card"><div class="cs-h">' + esc(b.title) + '</div><ul class="cs-ul">' + b.points.map(p => '<li>' + esc(p) + '</li>').join("") + '</ul></div><button class="cs-btn" id="fin">Finish lesson</button>';
  }
  root.innerHTML = h;
  const nx = document.getElementById("nx"); if (nx) nx.onclick = next;
  const fin = document.getElementById("fin"); if (fin) fin.onclick = finish;
  if (b.type === "listen") bindListen(b);
  startTeacher(b);
}

/* ---- listening block ---- */
function transcript(b) { return '<div class="cs-tr">' + b.lines.map(l => '<b>' + (l.v === "F" ? "Woman" : l.v === "H" ? "Man" : "Announcer") + '</b>' + esc(l.t)).join("") + '</div>'; }
function listenHtml(b) {
  const chk = S.checked[b.id];
  let h = '<div class="cs-card"><div class="cs-h">' + esc(b.title) + '</div><p class="cs-p">' + esc(b.instr) + '</p>' +
    '<div class="cs-play"><button class="cs-pb" id="pb" disabled>▶</button><div class="cs-wave"><i id="pw"></i></div><span class="cs-pst" id="ps">Preparing audio...</span></div>' +
    (b.transcript === "before" ? transcript(b) : "") + (b.transcript === "after" && chk ? transcript(b) : "");
  b.questions.forEach((q, qi) => {
    const a = S.answers[b.id + q.id], r = chk && chk.res[q.id];
    h += '<div class="cs-q">' + (qi + 1) + '. ' + esc(q.q) + '</div>';
    if (q.type === "fill") h += '<input class="cs-fill ' + (chk ? (r.ok ? "ok" : "bad") : "") + '" data-q="' + q.id + '" value="' + esc(a || "") + '" ' + (chk ? "disabled" : "") + ' placeholder="Your answer" autocomplete="off">';
    else q.opts.forEach((o, oi) => { let c = "cs-opt"; if (chk) { if (oi === q.ans) c += " ok"; else if (a === oi) c += " bad"; } else if (a === oi) c += " sel"; h += '<button class="' + c + '" data-q="' + q.id + '" data-o="' + oi + '"' + (chk ? " disabled" : "") + '>' + esc(o) + '</button>'; });
    if (chk) h += '<div class="cs-ex">' + (q.type === "fill" ? '<b>' + (r.ok ? "Correct. " : "The answer is " + esc(q.accepted[0]) + ". ") + '</b>' : "") + esc(q.expl) + '</div>';
  });
  if (chk) h += '<div class="cs-score">' + chk.got + ' / ' + b.questions.length + ' correct</div><button class="cs-btn" id="nx">Continue</button>';
  else h += '<button class="cs-btn" id="ck" disabled>Check my answers</button>';
  return h + '</div>';
}
function bindListen(b) {
  const chk = S.checked[b.id];
  root.querySelectorAll(".cs-opt").forEach(o => o.onclick = () => { if (chk) return; S.answers[b.id + o.dataset.q] = +o.dataset.o; root.querySelectorAll('.cs-opt[data-q="' + o.dataset.q + '"]').forEach(x => x.classList.remove("sel")); o.classList.add("sel"); ready(b); });
  root.querySelectorAll(".cs-fill").forEach(f => f.oninput = () => { S.answers[b.id + f.dataset.q] = f.value; ready(b); });
  const ck = document.getElementById("ck"); if (ck) { ready(b); ck.onclick = () => check(b); }
  const nx = document.getElementById("nx"); if (nx) nx.onclick = next;
  setupAudio(b);
}
function ready(b) { const ck = document.getElementById("ck"); if (!ck) return; ck.disabled = !b.questions.every(q => { const a = S.answers[b.id + q.id]; return q.type === "fill" ? String(a || "").trim() : a != null; }); }
function check(b) {
  const res = {}; let got = 0;
  b.questions.forEach(q => { const a = S.answers[b.id + q.id]; const ok = q.type === "fill" ? q.accepted.some(x => nf(x) === nf(a)) : a === q.ans; res[q.id] = { ok }; if (ok) got++; });
  S.checked[b.id] = { res, got }; const keepAudio = S.audio[b.id]; show();
}

/* ---- audio: fetched ahead and played from a blob so it also works on iPhone ---- */
function stopAudio() { if (S.el) { try { S.el.pause(); } catch (e) { } S.el = null; } }
function fetchAudio(b, force) {
  let a = S.audio[b.id]; if (a && !force) return a; a = S.audio[b.id] = { state: "loading", url: null };
  a.p = (async () => { const r = await api("/api/delf/tts-lines", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ lines: b.lines, level }) }); if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status); a.url = URL.createObjectURL(await r.blob()); a.state = "ready"; })().catch(() => { a.state = "error"; });
  return a;
}
function setupAudio(b) {
  const a = fetchAudio(b); const pb = document.getElementById("pb"), ps = document.getElementById("ps"), pw = document.getElementById("pw");
  const paint = () => { if (!document.getElementById("pb")) return; if (a.state === "loading") { pb.disabled = true; ps.textContent = "Preparing audio..."; } else if (a.state === "error") { pb.disabled = false; pb.textContent = "↻"; ps.textContent = "Tap to retry"; } else { pb.disabled = false; pb.textContent = S.el ? "❚❚" : "▶"; ps.textContent = S.el ? "Playing" : "Tap to play"; } };
  paint(); a.p.then(paint);
  pb.onclick = () => {
    if (a.state === "error") { fetchAudio(b, true).p.then(() => setupAudio(b)); setupAudio(b); return; }
    if (a.state !== "ready") return;
    try { S.narr.pause(); } catch (e) { } S.narrOn = false;
    if (S.el) { stopAudio(); pw.style.width = "0"; paint(); return; }
    const au = new Audio(a.url); S.el = au;
    au.ontimeupdate = () => { if (au.duration) pw.style.width = Math.round(au.currentTime / au.duration * 100) + "%"; };
    au.onended = () => { S.el = null; pw.style.width = "100%"; paint(); ps.textContent = "Tap to replay"; };
    au.onerror = () => { S.el = null; paint(); };
    au.play().then(paint).catch(() => { S.el = null; paint(); });
  };
}

async function finish() {
  const b = document.getElementById("fin"); b.disabled = true; b.textContent = "Saving...";
  try { const r = await api("/api/delf/journey/lesson", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ level, step: id }) }); if (!r.ok) throw 0; location.href = back; }
  catch (e) { b.disabled = false; b.textContent = "Could not save. Tap to try again"; }
}

import { onAuthStateChanged } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth.js";
var body = document.getElementById("tpBody");
var LEVELS = ["a1","a2","b1","b2","c1"];
var META = { a1:"Beginner", a2:"Elementary", b1:"Intermediate", b2:"Upper intermediate", c1:"Advanced (DALF)" };
function load(token, tries){
  return fetch(API_BASE + "/api/delf/prices", { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer " + token } }).then(function(r){
    if(r.ok) return r.json();
    throw new Error(r.status);
  }).catch(function(e){
    if(tries > 1) return new Promise(function(res){ setTimeout(res, 5000); }).then(function(){ return load(token, tries - 1); });
    throw e;
  });
}
function draw(items){
  var by = {}; items.forEach(function(i){ by[i.exam] = i; });
  var rows = LEVELS.map(function(k){
    var it = by[k]; if(!it) return "";
    var label = k.toUpperCase();
    if(it.owned) return '<a class="tp-row tp-own" href="/delf/journey.html?l=' + k + '"><span class="tp-badge">' + label + '</span><span class="tp-mid"><div class="tp-name">DELF ' + label + '</div><div class="tp-meta">' + META[k] + ' &middot; 10 mock exams</div></span><span class="tp-act"><span class="tp-open">Open</span></span></a>';
    return '<a class="tp-row" href="/delf/payment.html?exam=' + k + '"><span class="tp-badge">' + label + '</span><span class="tp-mid"><div class="tp-name">DELF ' + label + '</div><div class="tp-meta">' + META[k] + '</div></span><span class="tp-act tp-price">$' + it.usd + (it.ghs ? '<small>about GH₵' + it.ghs + '</small>' : '') + '</span></a>';
  }).join("");
  var own = LEVELS.filter(function(k){ return by[k] && by[k].owned; }).length;
  body.innerHTML = '<div class="tp-list">' + rows + '</div><p class="tp-foot">' + (own ? own + (own === 1 ? " level" : " levels") + " unlocked. Tap a level to open it." : "Tap a level to see what is included and unlock it.") + '</p>';
}
onAuthStateChanged(auth, function(user){
  if(!user || (user.isAnonymous && !user.email)){
    body.innerHTML = '<p class="tp-msg">Please log in to your SayBon account to see your levels.</p><button class="tp-btn" onclick="location.href=\'/auth/login.html\'">Log In</button>';
    return;
  }
  user.getIdToken().then(function(t){ return load(t, 8); }).then(function(d){ draw(d.items || []); })
    .catch(function(){ body.innerHTML = '<p class="tp-msg">We could not load your levels just now. Please refresh in a moment.</p>'; });
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
function loadDomains(){
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/assetDomainsList").then(r=>r.json()).then(function(items){
    const list = document.getElementById("dList");
    if(!items || !items.length){ list.innerHTML = '<p class="as-empty">No domains added yet</p>'; return; }
    list.innerHTML = items.map(function(it){
      return '<div class="as-item"><div><div class="as-item-title">'+it.name+'</div><div class="as-item-meta">'+it.registrar+' - renews '+it.renewalDate+' - $'+Number(it.cost).toFixed(2)+'/yr</div></div><div class="as-item-actions"><button onclick="deleteDomain(\''+it.id+'\')">Delete</button></div></div>';
    }).join("");
  }).catch(function(){ document.getElementById("dList").innerHTML = '<p class="as-empty">Could not load</p>'; });
}
window.deleteDomain = function(id){
  if(!confirm("Delete this domain?")) return;
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/assetDomainsDelete", {method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({id})}).then(loadDomains);
};
document.getElementById("dAddBtn").addEventListener("click", function(){
  const name = document.getElementById("dName").value.trim();
  if(!name) return;
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/assetDomainsAdd", {method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({
    name, registrar: document.getElementById("dRegistrar").value, cost: parseFloat(document.getElementById("dCost").value)||0, renewalDate: document.getElementById("dRenewal").value
  })}).then(function(){ document.getElementById("dName").value=""; document.getElementById("dRegistrar").value=""; document.getElementById("dCost").value=""; loadDomains(); });
});
loadDomains();
</script>

<script type="module">
import { auth } from "/js/firebase-init.js";
import { onAuthStateChanged } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth.js";

const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
let idToken = "";

async function loadVoices(){
  try{
    const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/sonioxVoices");
    const models = await res.json();
    const voiceSelect = document.getElementById("asVoice");
    voiceSelect.innerHTML = "";
    const model = models.find(m => m.id === "tts-rt-v2") || models[0];
    model.voices.forEach(v => {
      const opt = document.createElement("option");
      opt.value = v.id;
      opt.textContent = v.id + " (" + v.gender + ") - " + v.description.slice(0, 60);
      voiceSelect.appendChild(opt);
    });
  }catch(err){
    console.error("VOICES LOAD ERROR:", err);
  }
}

async function loadLibrary(){
  const container = document.getElementById("asLibrary");
  try{
    const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/listGeneratedAudio", {
      headers: { "Authorization": "Bearer " + idToken }
    });
    const items = await res.json();
    if(!items || !items.length){
      container.innerHTML = '<p class="as-empty">No audio generated yet.</p>';
      return;
    }
    container.innerHTML = "";
    items.forEach(it => {
      const div = document.createElement("div");
      div.className = "as-lib-item";
      div.innerHTML =
        '<div class="as-lib-meta">' + (it.destinationSection||"-") + ' &middot; ' + (it.destinationItem||"-") + ' &middot; ' + (it.purpose||"-") + ' &middot; ' + (it.voice||"-") + '</div>' +
        '<div class="as-lib-text">' + (it.text||"").slice(0,150) + '</div>' +
        '<audio controls style="width:100%;" src="' + it.url + '"></audio>' +
        '<a href="https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com/api/downloadAudio?url=' + encodeURIComponent(it.url) + '" style="color:#d4af6a;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;margin-top:6px;display:inline-block;">Download</a>';
      container.appendChild(div);
    });
  }catch(err){
    console.error("LIBRARY LOAD ERROR:", err);
    container.innerHTML = '<p class="as-empty">Could not load audio library.</p>';
  }
}

document.getElementById("asGenerateBtn").addEventListener("click", async function(){
  const btn = document.getElementById("asGenerateBtn");
  const status = document.getElementById("asStatus");
  const text = document.getElementById("asText").value.trim();
  const voice = document.getElementById("asVoice").value;
  if(!text || !voice){
    status.innerText = "Please enter text and select a voice.";
    return;
  }
  btn.disabled = true;
  status.innerText = "Generating audio...";
  try{
    const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/generateLessonAudio", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        text: text,
        language: document.getElementById("asLanguage").value,
        voice: voice,
        destinationSection: document.getElementById("asSection").value,
        destinationItem: document.getElementById("asItem").value,
        purpose: document.getElementById("asPurpose").value
      })
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if(!data.success){
      status.innerText = data.error || "Could not generate audio.";
      btn.disabled = false;
      return;
    }
    const preview = document.getElementById("asPreview");
    preview.src = data.url;
    preview.style.display = "block";
    const downloadLink = document.getElementById("asDownloadLink");
    downloadLink.href = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com/api/downloadAudio?url=" + encodeURIComponent(data.url);
    downloadLink.style.display = "inline-block";
    status.innerText = "Generated and saved to library.";
    btn.disabled = false;
    loadLibrary();
  }catch(err){
    console.error("GENERATE ERROR:", err);
    status.innerText = "Could not generate audio.";
    btn.disabled = false;
  }
});

onAuthStateChanged(auth, async function(user){
  if(user){
    idToken = await user.getIdToken();
    loadLibrary();
  }
});

function setupTagButtons(){
  var tags = ["whispering","excited","laughing","sad","happy","hesitant","shouting","calm","curious","nervous","gasp","sighing"];
  var row = document.getElementById("asTagRow");
  tags.forEach(function(tag){
    var btn = document.createElement("button");
    btn.type = "button";
    btn.className = "as-tag-btn";
    btn.textContent = "[" + tag + "]";
    btn.onclick = function(){
      var textarea = document.getElementById("asText");
      var start = textarea.selectionStart;
      var end = textarea.selectionEnd;
      var insertText = "[" + tag + "] ";
      textarea.value = textarea.value.slice(0, start) + insertText + textarea.value.slice(end);
      textarea.focus();
      textarea.selectionStart = textarea.selectionEnd = start + insertText.length;
    };
    row.appendChild(btn);
  });
}

setupTagButtons();
loadVoices();
</script>

export async function adminLogin() {
  try {
    const result = await signInWithPopup(auth, provider);
    const user = result.user;

    if (!ADMIN_EMAILS.includes(user.email)) {
      alert("Access denied. Admin only.");
      await auth.signOut();
      return;
    }

    window.location.href = "/features/admin/";
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err);
    alert("Admin login failed.");
  }
}


===== FILE: public\features\admin\auth\admin-guard.js (1423 bytes) =====
import { auth } from "/js/firebase-init.js";
import { onAuthStateChanged } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth.js";

const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";

document.body.style.visibility = "hidden";

onAuthStateChanged(auth, async function(user){
  if(!user){
    window.location.href = "/auth/login.html";
    return;
  }

  try{
    const res = await fetch(API_BASE + "/api/accessControlCheck?email=" + encodeURIComponent(user.email || ""));
    const data = await res.json();

    if(data.authorized){ document.body.style.visibility = "visible"; window.dispatchEvent(new Event("adminAuthorized")); } else {
      document.body.innerHTML = "<div style='font-family:sans-serif;color:#fff;background:#0c1016;min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:40px;'><div><h1>Access Denied</h1><p>Your account is not authorized for Business Admin.</p></div></div>";
      document.body.style.visibility = "visible";
    }
  }catch(err){
    console.error("Access check failed:", err);
    document.body.innerHTML = "<div style='font-family:sans-serif;color:#fff;background:#0c1016;min-height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:40px;'><div><h1>Could not verify access</h1><p>Please try again shortly.</p></div></div>";
    document.body.style.visibility = "visible";
  }
});

const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
import { app, auth } from "/js/firebase-init.js";
import { signInAnonymously } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth.js";
import { getStorage, ref, uploadBytes, getDownloadURL } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-storage.js";
const storage = getStorage(app, "gs://saybon-3e3c2.firebasestorage.app");


function loadDocs(){
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/docBusinessPlan" + "List").then(r=>r.json()).then(function(items){
    const list = document.getElementById("docList");
    if(!items || !items.length){ list.innerHTML = '<p class="dc-empty">No documents yet</p>'; return; }
    list.innerHTML = items.map(function(it){
      const link = it.fileUrl ? '<a class="dc-item-link" href="'+it.fileUrl+'" target="_blank">Open</a>' : '';
      return '<div class="dc-item"><div><div class="dc-item-title">'+it.title+'</div><div class="dc-item-meta">'+(it.meta||'')+' '+link+'</div></div><div class="dc-item-actions"><button onclick="deleteDoc(\''+it.id+'\')">Delete</button></div></div>';
    }).join("");
  }).catch(function(){ document.getElementById("docList").innerHTML = '<p class="dc-empty">Could not load</p>'; });
}
window.deleteDoc = function(id){
  if(!confirm("Delete this document?")) return;
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/docBusinessPlan" + "Delete", {method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({id})}).then(loadDocs);
};

document.getElementById("docAddBtn").addEventListener("click", async function(){
  const status = document.getElementById("docStatus");
  const title = document.getElementById("docTitle").value.trim();
  if(!title){ status.textContent = "Title is required"; return; }

  status.textContent = "Saving...";
  const metaText = document.getElementById("docMeta").value;
  const payload = { title, meta: metaText, fileUrl: null };

  const file = document.getElementById("docFile").files[0];
  if(file){
    const storageRef = ref(storage, "companyDocuments/businessPlan/" + Date.now() + "-" + file.name);
    const snap = await uploadBytes(storageRef, file);
    payload.fileUrl = await getDownloadURL(snap.ref);
  }

  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/docBusinessPlan" + "Add", {method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify(payload)})
    .then(function(){ status.textContent = "Uploaded"; document.getElementById("docTitle").value=""; document.getElementById("docFile").value=""; loadDocs(); })
    .catch(function(){ status.textContent = "Failed to save"; });
});

loadDocs();
</script>
</body></html>

const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
import { app, auth } from "/js/firebase-init.js";
import { signInAnonymously } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth.js";
import { getStorage, ref, uploadBytes, getDownloadURL } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-storage.js";
const storage = getStorage(app, "gs://saybon-3e3c2.firebasestorage.app");


function loadDocs(){
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/docNda" + "List").then(r=>r.json()).then(function(items){
    const list = document.getElementById("docList");
    if(!items || !items.length){ list.innerHTML = '<p class="dc-empty">No documents yet</p>'; return; }
    list.innerHTML = items.map(function(it){
      const link = it.fileUrl ? '<a class="dc-item-link" href="'+it.fileUrl+'" target="_blank">Open</a>' : '';
      return '<div class="dc-item"><div><div class="dc-item-title">'+it.title+'</div><div class="dc-item-meta">'+(it.meta||'')+' '+link+'</div></div><div class="dc-item-actions"><button onclick="deleteDoc(\''+it.id+'\')">Delete</button></div></div>';
    }).join("");
  }).catch(function(){ document.getElementById("docList").innerHTML = '<p class="dc-empty">Could not load</p>'; });
}
window.deleteDoc = function(id){
  if(!confirm("Delete this document?")) return;
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/docNda" + "Delete", {method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({id})}).then(loadDocs);
};

document.getElementById("docAddBtn").addEventListener("click", async function(){
  const status = document.getElementById("docStatus");
  const title = document.getElementById("docTitle").value.trim();
  if(!title){ status.textContent = "Title is required"; return; }

  status.textContent = "Saving...";
  const metaText = document.getElementById("docParty").value + " - " + document.getElementById("docDate").value;
  const payload = { title, meta: metaText, fileUrl: null };

  const file = document.getElementById("docFile").files[0];
  if(file){
    const storageRef = ref(storage, "companyDocuments/nda/" + Date.now() + "-" + file.name);
    const snap = await uploadBytes(storageRef, file);
    payload.fileUrl = await getDownloadURL(snap.ref);
  }

  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/docNda" + "Add", {method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify(payload)})
    .then(function(){ status.textContent = "Uploaded"; document.getElementById("docTitle").value=""; document.getElementById("docFile").value=""; loadDocs(); })
    .catch(function(){ status.textContent = "Failed to save"; });
});

loadDocs();

<script>
const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";

function loadItems(){
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminFeedbackList")
    .then(function(res){ return res.json(); })
    .then(renderItems)
    .catch(function(){ document.getElementById("fbList").innerHTML = '<p class="fb-empty">Could not load list</p>'; });
}

function renderItems(items){
  const list = document.getElementById("fbList");
  if(!items || items.length === 0){
    list.innerHTML = '<p class="fb-empty">Nothing logged yet</p>';
    return;
  }
  list.innerHTML = items.map(function(it){
    const date = it.created ? new Date(it.created._seconds * 1000).toLocaleDateString() : "";
    return '<div class="fb-item ' + (it.resolved ? "resolved" : "") + '">' +
      '<div class="fb-item-top"><span class="fb-tag fb-tag-' + it.type + '">' + it.type + '</span></div>' +
      '<div class="fb-item-text">' + it.text + '</div>' +
      '<div class="fb-item-date">' + date + '</div>' +
      '<div class="fb-item-actions">' +
      '<button onclick="toggleResolved(\'' + it.id + '\', ' + !it.resolved + ')">' + (it.resolved ? "Reopen" : "Mark Resolved") + '</button>' +
      '<button onclick="deleteItem(\'' + it.id + '\')">Delete</button>' +
      '</div></div>';
  }).join("");
}

document.getElementById("fbAddBtn").addEventListener("click", function(){
  const type = document.getElementById("fbType").value;
  const text = document.getElementById("fbText").value.trim();
  if(!text) return;

  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminFeedbackAdd", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ type: type, text: text })
  }).then(function(){
    document.getElementById("fbText").value = "";
    loadItems();
  });
});

function toggleResolved(id, resolved){
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminFeedbackUpdate", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ id: id, resolved: resolved })
  }).then(loadItems);
}

function deleteItem(id){
  if(!confirm("Delete this item?")) return;
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminFeedbackDelete", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ id: id })
  }).then(loadItems);
}

loadItems();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<script type="module">
const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
import { app, auth } from "/js/firebase-init.js";
import { signInAnonymously } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth.js";
import { getStorage, ref, uploadBytes, getDownloadURL } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-storage.js";
const storage = getStorage(app, "gs://saybon-3e3c2.firebasestorage.app");

function loadExpenses(){
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/financeExpenseList").then(r=>r.json()).then(renderExpenses).catch(()=>{ document.getElementById("expList").innerHTML = '<p class="fn-empty">Could not load</p>'; });
}
function renderExpenses(items){
  const list = document.getElementById("expList");
  if(!items || !items.length){ list.innerHTML = '<p class="fn-empty">No expenses logged yet</p>'; return; }
  list.innerHTML = items.map(it => {
    const receiptHtml = it.receiptUrl ? '<a class="fn-receipt-link" href="'+it.receiptUrl+'" target="_blank">Receipt</a>' : '';
    return '<div class="fn-item"><div class="fn-item-left"><div class="fn-item-cat">'+it.category+'</div><div class="fn-item-note">'+(it.note||'')+'</div><div class="fn-item-meta">'+it.date+' - '+it.method+' '+receiptHtml+'</div></div><div class="fn-item-amount expense">-'+it.currency+' '+Number(it.amount).toFixed(2)+'</div><div class="fn-item-actions"><button onclick="deleteExpense(\''+it.id+'\')">Delete</button></div></div>';
  }).join("");
}
window.deleteExpense = function(id){
  if(!confirm("Delete this entry?")) return;
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/financeExpenseDelete", {method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({id})}).then(loadExpenses);
};



document.getElementById("expAddBtn").addEventListener("click", async function(){
  const status = document.getElementById("expStatus");
  const amount = document.getElementById("expAmount").value;
  const date = document.getElementById("expDate").value;
  if(!amount || !date){ status.textContent = "Amount and date are required"; return; }

  status.textContent = "Saving...";
  const payload = {
    date, amount: parseFloat(amount),
    currency: document.getElementById("expCurrency").value,
    method: document.getElementById("expMethod").value,
    category: document.getElementById("expCategory").value,
    note: document.getElementById("expNote").value,
    receiptUrl: null
  };

  const file = document.getElementById("expFile").files[0];
  if(file){
    const storageRef = ref(storage, "financeReceipts/expenses/" + Date.now() + "-" + file.name);
    const snap = await uploadBytes(storageRef, file);
    payload.receiptUrl = await getDownloadURL(snap.ref);
  }

  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/financeExpenseAdd", {method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify(payload)})
    .then(()=>{ status.textContent = "Added"; document.getElementById("expAmount").value=""; document.getElementById("expNote").value=""; document.getElementById("expFile").value=""; loadExpenses(); })
    .catch(()=>{ status.textContent = "Failed to save"; });
});

loadExpenses();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<script>
const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";

function loadFounderData(){
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/financeFounderSummary").then(r=>r.json()).then(function(data){
    document.getElementById("fdProfit").textContent = "USD " + Number(data.profit).toFixed(2);
    document.getElementById("fdPercentDisplay").textContent = data.percent + "%";
    document.getElementById("fdAvailable").textContent = "USD " + Number(data.available).toFixed(2);
    document.getElementById("fdTaken").textContent = "USD " + Number(data.taken).toFixed(2);
    document.getElementById("fdPercentInput").value = data.percent;

    const list = document.getElementById("fdList");
    if(!data.draws || !data.draws.length){ list.innerHTML = '<p class="fn-empty">No draws logged yet</p>'; return; }
    list.innerHTML = data.draws.map(function(d){
      return '<div class="fn-item"><div class="fn-item-left"><div class="fn-item-note">'+(d.note||'Draw')+'</div><div class="fn-item-meta">'+d.date+'</div></div><div class="fn-item-amount expense">-'+d.currency+' '+Number(d.amount).toFixed(2)+'</div><div class="fn-item-actions"><button onclick="deleteDraw(\''+d.id+'\')">Delete</button></div></div>';
    }).join("");
  }).catch(function(){ document.getElementById("fdList").innerHTML = '<p class="fn-empty">Could not load</p>'; });
}

window.deleteDraw = function(id){
  if(!confirm("Delete this draw?")) return;
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/financeFounderDrawDelete", {method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({id})}).then(loadFounderData);
};

document.getElementById("fdSavePercentBtn").addEventListener("click", function(){
  const percent = parseFloat(document.getElementById("fdPercentInput").value);
  if(isNaN(percent)) return;
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/financeFounderSetPercent", {method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({percent})}).then(loadFounderData);
});

document.getElementById("fdLogBtn").addEventListener("click", function(){
  const status = document.getElementById("fdStatus");
  const amount = document.getElementById("fdAmount").value;
  const date = document.getElementById("fdDate").value;
  if(!amount || !date){ status.textContent = "Amount and date are required"; return; }

  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/financeFounderDrawAdd", {
    method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},
    body:JSON.stringify({ date, amount: parseFloat(amount), currency: document.getElementById("fdCurrency").value, note: document.getElementById("fdNote").value })
  }).then(function(){
    status.textContent = "Draw logged";
    document.getElementById("fdAmount").value = "";
    document.getElementById("fdNote").value = "";
    loadFounderData();
  }).catch(function(){ status.textContent = "Failed to save"; });
});

loadFounderData();
</script>

const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
import { app, auth } from "/js/firebase-init.js";
import { signInAnonymously } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-auth.js";
import { getStorage, ref, uploadBytes, getDownloadURL } from "https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.0/firebase-storage.js";
const storage = getStorage(app, "gs://saybon-3e3c2.firebasestorage.app");

function loadIncome(){
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/financeIncomeList").then(r=>r.json()).then(renderIncome).catch(()=>{ document.getElementById("incList").innerHTML = '<p class="fn-empty">Could not load</p>'; });
}
function renderIncome(items){
  const list = document.getElementById("incList");
  if(!items || !items.length){ list.innerHTML = '<p class="fn-empty">No income logged yet</p>'; return; }
  list.innerHTML = items.map(it => {
    const receiptHtml = it.receiptUrl ? '<a class="fn-receipt-link" href="'+it.receiptUrl+'" target="_blank">Receipt</a>' : '';
    return '<div class="fn-item"><div class="fn-item-left"><div class="fn-item-cat">'+it.category+'</div><div class="fn-item-note">'+(it.note||'')+'</div><div class="fn-item-meta">'+it.date+' - '+it.method+' '+receiptHtml+'</div></div><div class="fn-item-amount income">+'+it.currency+' '+Number(it.amount).toFixed(2)+'</div><div class="fn-item-actions"><button onclick="deleteIncome(\''+it.id+'\')">Delete</button></div></div>';
  }).join("");
}
window.deleteIncome = function(id){
  if(!confirm("Delete this entry?")) return;
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/financeIncomeDelete", {method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({id})}).then(loadIncome);
};



document.getElementById("incAddBtn").addEventListener("click", async function(){
  const status = document.getElementById("incStatus");
  const amount = document.getElementById("incAmount").value;
  const date = document.getElementById("incDate").value;
  if(!amount || !date){ status.textContent = "Amount and date are required"; return; }

  status.textContent = "Saving...";
  const payload = {
    date, amount: parseFloat(amount),
    currency: document.getElementById("incCurrency").value,
    method: document.getElementById("incMethod").value,
    category: document.getElementById("incCategory").value,
    note: document.getElementById("incNote").value,
    receiptUrl: null
  };

  const file = document.getElementById("incFile").files[0];
  if(file){
    const storageRef = ref(storage, "financeReceipts/income/" + Date.now() + "-" + file.name);
    const snap = await uploadBytes(storageRef, file);
    payload.receiptUrl = await getDownloadURL(snap.ref);
  }

  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/financeIncomeAdd", {method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify(payload)})
    .then(()=>{ status.textContent = "Added"; document.getElementById("incAmount").value=""; document.getElementById("incNote").value=""; document.getElementById("incFile").value=""; loadIncome(); })
    .catch(()=>{ status.textContent = "Failed to save"; });
});

loadIncome();
</script>

<script>
const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
function loadCap(){
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/capTableList").then(r=>r.json()).then(function(items){
    const list = document.getElementById("cList");
    let total = 0;
    if(!items || !items.length){ list.innerHTML = '<p class="iv-empty">No owners added yet</p>'; }
    else {
      list.innerHTML = items.map(function(it){
        total += Number(it.percent)||0;
        return '<div class="iv-item"><div><div class="iv-item-title">'+it.name+'</div><div class="iv-item-meta">'+(it.date||'')+' '+(it.notes||'')+'</div></div><div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;"><div class="iv-item-pct">'+it.percent+'%</div><div class="iv-item-actions"><button onclick="deleteOwner(\''+it.id+'\')">Delete</button></div></div></div>';
      }).join("");
    }
    document.getElementById("cTotalFill").style.width = Math.min(total,100) + "%";
    document.getElementById("cTotalLabel").textContent = total + "% allocated" + (total > 100 ? " (over 100% - check entries)" : "");
  }).catch(function(){ document.getElementById("cList").innerHTML = '<p class="iv-empty">Could not load</p>'; });
}
window.deleteOwner = function(id){
  if(!confirm("Delete this owner?")) return;
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/capTableDelete", {method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({id})}).then(loadCap);
};
document.getElementById("cAddBtn").addEventListener("click", function(){
  const name = document.getElementById("cName").value.trim();
  const percent = parseFloat(document.getElementById("cPercent").value);
  const status = document.getElementById("cStatus");
  if(!name || isNaN(percent)){ status.textContent = "Name and percentage are required"; return; }
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/capTableAdd", {method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({
    name, percent, date: document.getElementById("cDate").value, notes: document.getElementById("cNotes").value
  })}).then(function(){ status.textContent = "Added"; document.getElementById("cName").value=""; document.getElementById("cPercent").value=""; document.getElementById("cNotes").value=""; loadCap(); });
});
loadCap();

function loadTerms(){
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/investorTermsList").then(r=>r.json()).then(function(items){
    const list = document.getElementById("tList");
    if(!items || !items.length){ list.innerHTML = '<p class="iv-empty">No terms recorded yet</p>'; return; }
    list.innerHTML = items.map(function(it){
      return '<div class="iv-item"><div><div class="iv-item-title">'+it.title+'</div><div class="iv-item-meta">'+(it.details||'')+' - '+(it.date||'')+'</div></div><div class="iv-item-actions"><button onclick="deleteTerm(\''+it.id+'\')">Delete</button></div></div>';
    }).join("");
  }).catch(function(){ document.getElementById("tList").innerHTML = '<p class="iv-empty">Could not load</p>'; });
}
window.deleteTerm = function(id){
  if(!confirm("Delete this record?")) return;
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/investorTermsDelete", {method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({id})}).then(loadTerms);
};
document.getElementById("tAddBtn").addEventListener("click", function(){
  const title = document.getElementById("tTitle").value.trim();
  if(!title) return;
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/investorTermsAdd", {method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({
    title, details: document.getElementById("tDetails").value, date: document.getElementById("tDate").value
  })}).then(function(){ document.getElementById("tTitle").value=""; document.getElementById("tDetails").value=""; loadTerms(); });
});
loadTerms();

===== FILE: public\features\admin\passkeys\passkeys.js (4217 bytes) =====
(function () {
  const STORAGE_KEY = "saybon_admin_generated_passkeys";
  const ACTIVE_RECORD_KEY = "saybon_admin_active_passkey_record";

  const accessMeta = document.getElementById("accessMeta");
  const nameInput = document.getElementById("nameInput");
  const employeeIdInput = document.getElementById("employeeIdInput");
  const roleInput = document.getElementById("roleInput");
  const passkeyInput = document.getElementById("passkeyInput");
  const generateBtn = document.getElementById("generateBtn");
  const saveBtn = document.getElementById("saveBtn");
  const listWrap = document.getElementById("listWrap");

  function getActiveRecord() {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(ACTIVE_RECORD_KEY) || "null");
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }

  function getItems() {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      const parsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
      return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  function setItems(items) {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(items));
  }

  function randomBlock(len) {
    const chars = "ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789";
    let out = "";
    for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
      out += chars[Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length)];
    }
    return out;
  }

  function makePasskey() {
    return "SB-" + randomBlock(4) + "-" + randomBlock(4);
  }

  function render() {
    const items = getItems();

    if (!items.length) {
      listWrap.innerHTML = '<div class="passkey-item"><p>No employee admin passkeys created yet.</p></div>';
      return;
    }

    listWrap.innerHTML = items.map((item) => `
      <div class="passkey-item">
        <div class="top">
          <div>
            <h3>${item.name}</h3>
            <p><strong>ID:</strong> ${item.employeeId || "-"}</p>
            <p><strong>Role:</strong> ${item.role}</p>
            <p><strong>Passkey:</strong> ${item.passkey}</p>
          </div>
          <div class="badge ${item.enabled ? "" : "off"}">${item.enabled ? "ENABLED" : "DISABLED"}</div>
        </div>

        <div class="item-actions">
          <button class="toggle-btn" data-id="${item.id}">
            ${item.enabled ? "Disable" : "Enable"}
          </button>
          <button class="delete-btn" data-delete="${item.id}">
            Delete
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    `).join("");

    listWrap.querySelectorAll("[data-id]").forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const id = btn.getAttribute("data-id");
        const items = getItems().map(item => item.id === id ? { ...item, enabled: !item.enabled } : item);
        setItems(items);
        render();
      });
    });

    listWrap.querySelectorAll("[data-delete]").forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const id = btn.getAttribute("data-delete");
        const items = getItems().filter(item => item.id !== id);
        setItems(items);
        render();
      });
    });
  }

  const active = getActiveRecord();
  if (!active || active.role !== "master_admin") {
    accessMeta.textContent = "Master admin clearance required.";
    document.querySelector(".manager-grid").innerHTML = '<div class="panel"><h2>Access blocked</h2><p>Only the master passkey can generate employee admin passkeys.</p></div>';
    return;
  }

  accessMeta.textContent = `Master admin active: ${active.name}`;

  generateBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    passkeyInput.value = makePasskey();
  });

  saveBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const name = nameInput.value.trim();
    const employeeId = employeeIdInput.value.trim();
    const role = roleInput.value;
    const passkey = passkeyInput.value.trim();

    if (!name || !passkey) {
      alert("Enter employee name and passkey.");
      return;
    }

    const items = getItems();
    items.unshift({
      id: "pk_" + Date.now(),
      name,
      employeeId,
      role,
      passkey,
      enabled: true
    });

    setItems(items);

    nameInput.value = "";
    employeeIdInput.value = "";
    passkeyInput.value = "";
    roleInput.value = "employee_admin";

    render();
  });

  render();
})();

const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
let currentCandidate = null;
let currentTransferCode = null;

function loadCandidates(){
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminListPayoutCandidates").then(r => r.json()).then(function(items){
    const list = document.getElementById("pyList");
    if(!items || !items.length){ list.innerHTML = '<p class="py-empty">No translators currently owed a payable balance</p>'; return; }

    list.innerHTML = items.map(function(c){
      const methodDesc = c.method === "momo"
        ? c.momoNetwork + " - " + c.momoNumber
        : c.bankName + " - " + c.accountNumber;
      const actionBtn = c.isGhanaAutomatable
        ? '<button class="py-btn" onclick=\'openPaystackModal(' + JSON.stringify(c) + ')\'>Pay via Paystack</button>'
        : '<button class="py-btn py-btn-secondary" onclick="markManualPaid(\'' + c.passkey + '\', this)">Mark as Paid (Wired Manually)</button>';

      return '<div class="py-card"><div class="py-row"><div><div class="py-name">' + c.name + '</div><div class="py-meta">' + methodDesc + '</div><div class="py-tag ' + (c.isGhanaAutomatable ? 'py-tag-auto' : 'py-tag-manual') + '">' + (c.isGhanaAutomatable ? 'Ghana - Automated' : 'Manual') + '</div></div><div class="py-balance">$' + c.availableBalance.toFixed(2) + '</div></div>' + actionBtn + '</div>';
    }).join("");
  }).catch(function(){ document.getElementById("pyList").innerHTML = '<p class="py-empty">Could not load payout candidates</p>'; });
}

window.markManualPaid = function(passkey, btn){
  if(!confirm("Confirm you have already wired this payout manually?")) return;
  btn.disabled = true;
  btn.textContent = "Confirming...";
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminMarkPayoutPaidManually", {
    method: "POST", headers: {"Content-Type":"application/json", "Authorization": "Bearer " + (window.currentAdminIdToken || "")},
    body: JSON.stringify({ passkey })
  }).then(r => r.json()).then(function(data){
    if(data.success){ loadCandidates(); }
    else { btn.textContent = "Failed - try again"; btn.disabled = false; }
  });
};

window.openPaystackModal = function(candidate){
  currentCandidate = candidate;
  document.getElementById("pyPaystackModal").style.display = "flex";
  document.getElementById("pyModalStep1").style.display = "block";
  document.getElementById("pyModalStep2").style.display = "none";
  document.getElementById("pyModalStatus").textContent = "";
  document.getElementById("pyModalTitle").textContent = "Pay " + candidate.name + " - $" + candidate.availableBalance.toFixed(2);

  if(candidate.method === "momo"){
    document.getElementById("pyBankFieldWrap").style.display = "none";
  } else {
    document.getElementById("pyBankFieldWrap").style.display = "block";
    var select = document.getElementById("pyBankSelect");
    select.innerHTML = "<option>Loading banks...</option>";
    fetch(API_BASE + "/api/paystackBankList").then(r => r.json()).then(function(banks){
      select.innerHTML = banks.map(function(b){ return '<option value="' + b.code + '">' + b.name + '</option>'; }).join("");
    }).catch(function(){ select.innerHTML = "<option>Could not load banks</option>"; });
  }
};

function closePaystackModal(){
  document.getElementById("pyPaystackModal").style.display = "none";
  currentCandidate = null;
  currentTransferCode = null;
}

document.getElementById("pyInitiateBtn").addEventListener("click", function(){
  const status = document.getElementById("pyModalStatus");
  status.textContent = "Initiating transfer...";

  var momoNetworkCodeMap = { "MTN": "MTN", "Vodafone": "VOD", "AirtelTigo": "ATL" };

  var body = {
    passkey: currentCandidate.passkey,
    amount: currentCandidate.availableBalance,
    method: currentCandidate.method,
    accountName: currentCandidate.accountName
  };

  if(currentCandidate.method === "momo"){
    body.momoNumber = currentCandidate.momoNumber;
    body.momoNetworkCode = momoNetworkCodeMap[currentCandidate.momoNetwork] || currentCandidate.momoNetwork;
  } else {
    body.accountNumber = currentCandidate.accountNumber;
    body.bankCode = document.getElementById("pyBankSelect").value;
  }

  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminInitiatePaystackPayout", {
    method: "POST", headers: {"Content-Type":"application/json", "Authorization": "Bearer " + (window.currentAdminIdToken || "")}, body: JSON.stringify(body)
  }).then(r => r.json()).then(function(data){
    if(data.error){ status.textContent = data.error; return; }
    currentTransferCode = data.transferCode;
    if(data.requiresOtp){
      document.getElementById("pyModalStep1").style.display = "none";
      document.getElementById("pyModalStep2").style.display = "block";
      status.textContent = "";
    } else {
      status.textContent = "Transfer initiated - status: " + data.status;
    }
  }).catch(function(){ status.textContent = "Could not initiate transfer"; });
});

document.getElementById("pyFinalizeBtn").addEventListener("click", function(){
  const status = document.getElementById("pyModalStatus");
  const otp = document.getElementById("pyOtpInput").value.trim();
  if(!otp){ status.textContent = "Enter the OTP code"; return; }

  status.textContent = "Finalizing...";
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminFinalizePaystackPayout", {
    method: "POST", headers: {"Content-Type":"application/json", "Authorization": "Bearer " + (window.currentAdminIdToken || "")},
    body: JSON.stringify({ passkey: currentCandidate.passkey, transferCode: currentTransferCode, otp })
  }).then(r => r.json()).then(function(data){
    if(data.success){
      closePaystackModal();
      loadCandidates();
    } else {
      status.textContent = data.error || "Could not finalize transfer";
    }
  }).catch(function(){ status.textContent = "Could not finalize transfer"; });
});

loadCandidates();
</script>
</body>
</html>

const API_BASE = "https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com";
function loadReviews(){
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminPendingReviews").then(function(r){ return r.json(); }).then(function(items){
    var list = document.getElementById("rvList");
    if(!items || !items.length){ list.innerHTML = '<p class="rv-empty">No submissions waiting for review</p>'; return; }
    list.innerHTML = items.map(function(it){
      return '<div class="rv-card"><div class="rv-job-title">' + (it.clientFile||"Untitled") + ' — ' + it.targetLanguage + '</div><div class="rv-meta">Translator: ' + it.translator + '</div><div class="rv-score">' + it.finalScore + '%</div><div class="rv-meta">Claude Quality Score: ' + it.similarityScore + '% · Behavioral: ' + it.behavioralScore + '%</div><div class="rv-preview">' + it.translationPreview + '</div><div class="rv-btn-row"><button class="rv-btn" onclick="confirmSelection(&quot;' + it.jobId + '&quot;)">Confirm</button><button class="rv-btn rv-btn-secondary" onclick="showAlternatives(&quot;' + it.jobId + '&quot;, this)">See Other Submissions</button></div><div class="rv-alt-list" id="alt-' + it.jobId + '"></div></div>';
    }).join("");
  }).catch(function(){ document.getElementById("rvList").innerHTML = '<p class="rv-empty">Could not load reviews</p>'; });
}
window.confirmSelection = function(jobId){
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminConfirmSelection", { method: "POST", headers: {"Content-Type":"application/json"}, body: JSON.stringify({jobId: jobId}) }).then(function(){ loadReviews(); });
};
window.showAlternatives = function(jobId, btn){
  var altBox = document.getElementById("alt-" + jobId);
  if(altBox.style.display === "block"){ altBox.style.display = "none"; return; }
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminJobSubmissions?jobId=" + encodeURIComponent(jobId)).then(function(r){ return r.json(); }).then(function(subs){
    altBox.innerHTML = subs.map(function(s){
      return '<div class="rv-alt-item"><div>' + s.translator + ' — ' + (s.finalScore||"not scored") + '%</div><div class="rv-preview">' + s.translationPreview + '</div><button class="rv-btn rv-btn-secondary" onclick="overrideSelection(&quot;' + jobId + '&quot;,&quot;' + s.submissionId + '&quot;)">Use This One</button></div>';
    }).join("");
    altBox.style.display = "block";
  });
};
window.overrideSelection = function(jobId, submissionId){
  fetch(API_BASE + "/api/adminOverrideSelection", { method: "POST", headers: {"Content-Type":"application/json"}, body: JSON.stringify({jobId: jobId, submissionId: submissionId}) }).then(function(){ loadReviews(); });
};
loadReviews();
</script>

  <script>
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const category = params.get("category") || "";
    const level = params.get("level") || "";
    const price = Number(params.get("price") || "0");

    const categoryLabels = {
      prim: "DELF Prim",
      junior: "DELF Junior",
      public: "DELF Tout Public"
    };

    document.getElementById("title").textContent = `${categoryLabels[category] || "DELF"} ${level}`;
    document.getElementById("desc").textContent = "One-time payment for this DELF preparation level.";
    document.getElementById("price").textContent = `$${price}`;

    async function payNow(){
      try{
        const res = await fetch("https://saybonapp-server.onrender.com/api/createDelfCheckout", {
          method:"POST",
          headers:{ "Content-Type":"application/json" },
          body:JSON.stringify({ category, level, price })
        });

        const data = await res.json();

        if(!res.ok || !data.url){
          throw new Error(data.error || "Checkout failed.");
        }

        window.location.href = data.url;
      }catch(err){
        alert("Payment checkout is not ready yet. Please confirm the Render payment server endpoint is deployed.");
        console.error(err);
      }
    }
  </script>
</body>

  function bindNav() {
    nextBtn.onclick = async () => {
      if (!canProceed()) {
        centerNoteEl.textContent = "Complete this step, then continue.";
        return;

      if (currentIndex < questions.length - 1) {
        currentIndex += 1;
        renderQuestion();

    backBtn.onclick = () => {

        renderQuestion();

    const pill = document.createElement("div");

    pill.textContent = getPillLabel(q.type);
    stageEl.appendChild(pill);

    const question = document.createElement("h2");

    question.textContent = q.question || "Question";

      passage.textContent = q.passage;

    }
    else if (q.type === "speaking") {

    }

    backBtn.style.visibility = currentIndex === 0 ? "hidden" : "visible";
    nextBtn.textContent = currentIndex === questions.length - 1 ? "Finish" : "Next";
    nextBtn.classList.remove("hidden");

  }

  function getPillLabel(type) {

    wrap.appendChild(top);
    wrap.appendChild(controls);

    wrap.appendChild(audioBox);
